¿Qué ocurre si supero el límite mensual de mi plan?
Si superas el límite establecido, no podrás usar el producto hasta la renovación del período. Para obtener más minutos de video de inmediato, puedes actualizar el plan.
¿Puedo ver más opiniones de los clientes sobre Synthesia?
Por supuesto. En G2, nos seleccionaron como empresa de alto rendimiento. Puedes
leer las opiniones aquí
.
Nos esforzamos mucho a diario para mejorar y conseguir que Synthesia sea un producto aún más increíble en el futuro. También puedes ver nuestras
actualizaciones de productos frecuentes aquí
.
¿Los minutos de video no utilizados se transfieren al mes siguiente?
No.
Si al finalizar un período de facturación no has consumido todo el crédito de video asignado por tu plan, los videos no utilizados no se transfieren al período de facturación siguiente.
¿Puedo cancelar Synthesia en cualquier momento?
Sí. Solo debes acceder a la configuración de tu cuenta en Synthesia y cancelar tu plan.
¿Puedo actualizar mi cuenta en cualquier momento?
Sí. Si deseas actualizar tu plan Starter o Creator a un plan anual, ponte en contacto con el servicio de asistencia al cliente. Si deseas actualizar a un plan Enterprise, acude al equipo de ventas.
¿Cuánto cuesta Synthesia?
Para los usuarios del plan Starter, Synthesia cuesta USD 29 por mes o USD 264 si eliges un plan anual.
Para los usuarios del plan Creator, Synthesia cuesta USD 89 por mes o USD 804 por año si eliges el pago anual.
¿Puedo usar Synthesia de forma gratuita?
Puedes probar Synthesia gratis en la
página de video con IA gratis
. Allí, puedes elegir una plantilla de video, escribir tu guion de video y generar un video gratis.
¿Se hace un pago único para Synthesia?
No, Synthesia trabaja con pagos periódicos. Los usuarios de los planes Starter y Creator pueden elegir un ciclo de facturación mensual o anual. En el caso de los clientes de Enterprise, el ciclo de facturación es anual.
¿Cuánto cuesta un avatar personalizado?
Se incluye un avatar personal adaptado a tu gusto con los planes anuales Starter y Creator. Los planes Enterprise incluyen avatares personales ilimitados (sujeto a uso legítimo).
¿Cuántos videos puedo hacer con el plan Starter?
El plan Starter te ofrece 10 minutos de video por mes. La cantidad de videos que puedes generar depende de la duración de cada uno de esos videos.
Aquí tienes algunos ejemplos:
Si generas un video que dura 0:59 minutos, te quedarán otros 9:01 minutos de video para generar durante el mes.
Puedes generar 10 videos de 1 minuto o 1 video de 10 minutos.
¿Cómo y cuándo se consumen los minutos de video?
Los minutos de video se consumen solamente cuando se genera un video. Mientras tu video esté en borrador o estés usando la función de reproducción, no se consumirán créditos.
Si generaste tu video y deseas actualizar el contenido, puedes hacerlo editando el video y volviéndolo a generar.
‍
Ten en cuenta lo siguiente:
Solo contaremos los nuevos segundos de video. Por ejemplo, si editas un video existente que dura 1 minuto y le cambias 3 segundos, solo te cobraremos esos 3 segundos.
¿Puedo pagar por video?
No. Synthesia tiene suscripciones mensuales y anuales.
¿Quieres probar nuestro generador de videos con IA?
Únete hoy mismo a una comunidad de más de 1 millón de usuarios y comienza a hacer videos con IA eligiendo entre más de 240 avatares y más de 160 idiomas.

Presentamos el siguiente capítulo de Synthesia
Hoy puedo compartir una noticia que nos llena de entusiasmo: hemos recaudado USD 200 millones en la ronda de financiación Serie E, lo que lleva el valor de la empresa a USD 4000 millones. Es un hito significativo para nosotros, pero lo más importante es que da pie al siguiente capítulo de Synthesia.
¿Qué haremos con este nuevo capital?
Dicho en términos simples: reforzaremos nuestra plataforma de video con IA existente para fortalecer la comunicación visual y una serie nueva de productos diseñados para ayudar a que las personas trabajen mejor.
¿Por qué?
Porque creemos que las empresas exitosas del futuro serán aquellas capaces de enseñarles a sus empleados cómo aprovechar el poder de la IA en el trabajo. La automatización es un notable generador de valor, pero preparar a los empleados para que puedan crear sus propias automatizaciones será, en verdad, trascendental.
Y lo más importante son las personas
Eso es lo que diferencia a Synthesia de los demás: creemos fundamentalmente que las empresas seguirán poniendo a las personas por delante de todo durante mucho, mucho tiempo.
Por eso, para mí, una gran parte de nuestra misión es ayudar a que las personas trabajen mejor, formar a los equipos y agregar automatización donde tenga sentido hacerlo, para que todos puedan dedicar su tiempo a las tareas más importantes.
Y, con esta nueva ronda de financiación, redoblaremos esfuerzos para hacer exactamente eso.
A nuestros inversores, tanto a los nuevos como a los ya existentes, les damos las gracias por apoyar no solo un producto, sino la creencia de que hay una mejor manera de lograr que las organizaciones se adapten a la IA y crezcan.
Los próximos años redefinirán cómo se comparte el conocimiento en las mejores empresas del mundo. Y con esta nueva ronda de financiación, tenemos toda la intención de mejorar notoriamente esa experiencia para nuestros clientes.
A nuestros clientes, gracias por apostar por nosotros, por desafiarnos y por confiar en nosotros para resolver sus retos más importantes en cuanto a formación y comunicación. Ustedes son quienes nos muestran lo que es posible hacer con los agentes y videos con IA.

MISSION
Our mission is to help people work better
Our products aim to empower and amplify people’s capabilities, never to replace them. We value the unique qualities and insights only humans can bring, ensuring our technology always complements, not competes.
ETHICS
Ethical use of AI
Since 2017, we’ve been pioneering advancements in Generative AI. Ethics and AI safety have always been core to our mission, and to translate our commitments into action, we rely on our 3Cs framework:
Consent, Control, and Collaboration.
Here’s how it guides our decision-making:
Consent
We respect your right to your own image. You should decide how it's used. This means we will never create an AI avatar without your clear consent. This includes politicians or celebrities for satirical purposes. No impersonations, no gray areas.
Here’s how we ensure that:
Stock Avatars
Custom Avatars
Real people, real consent
: Our stock AI avatars are based on real human actors, with their explicit consent.
Fair play
: Actors are given clear and transparent information about how their likeness will be used, and are fairly compensated for their participation.
Opting out
: Our actors can choose to opt out. We respect that decision, ensuring a smooth transition.
Your image, your say
: Your avatar can be created only with your explicit consent, following a thorough KYC-like procedure.
Complete control
: Our platform ensures you can decide who uses your avatar, when, and how. No one can access it without your explicit consent.
Opting out
: You can request an opt-out. We guarantee your data and likeness will be entirely deleted from our databases.
Tab 1
Tab 2
Control
Our platform is more than just a tool. It's a secure environment for businesses, ensuring you and your company's data is safe and under your control.
Here's how we ensure this control:
Content Moderation Policy
: We implement rigorous content moderation at the point of creation, using advanced tech filters and human oversight to prevent inappropriate or harmful content.
Read more
Trust and Safety Team
: Our dedicated T&S team works around the clock to keep our platform safe and make sure it's used responsibly.
Tailored access
: We've designed user roles for tailored access, ensuring our tool benefits for all while keeping sensitive information secure for authorized individuals.
Your image, your say
: Your avatar can be created only with your explicit consent, following a thorough KYC-like procedure.
Complete control
: Our platform ensures you can decide who uses your avatar, when, and how. No one can access it without your explicit consent.
Opting out
: You can request an opt-out. We guarantee your data and likeness will be entirely deleted from our databases.
Collaboration
Tackling AI's challenges is a team effort. We believe in joining forces with industry leaders and regulators.
Our collaborative efforts include
:
Engaging with Regulatory Bodies
: We actively work with regulatory bodies and champion the formulation of robust AI policies and regulations.

Find out more about AI Actors
What is an AI actor?
An AI actor is a digital presenter that delivers your script on video. It looks and speaks like a real person, but you control it from text.
Teams use AI actors for training, marketing, and explainer videos to produce professional content without cameras, actors, or studios.
Can I create an AI actor that looks like me?
Yes. You can easily generate a custom AI actor that looks and sounds like you. Just record yourself using your webcam or phone, follow a few simple steps, and your AI actor will be generated.
What kind of videos can I make with AI actors?
AI actors support a wide range of video use cases. Teams use them to create training modules, onboarding programs, internal communications, product demos, customer education, and social media videos.
Is it free to try Synthesia’s AI actors?
Yes. You can create videos with AI actors for free in Synthesia. The free plan includes up to 10 minutes of video per month, so you can explore how AI actors fit into your workflow.
You can use customizable avatars at no cost. Prompt outfits, environments, and actions to match your message and audience. Write your script, choose an AI actor, and generate a professional video in minutes.
You can also try many core platform features, including AI Playground, video translation, AI Screen Recorder, video templates, and much more.
Do AI actors support multiple languages?
Yes. Synthesia AI actors support 160+ languages and 1,000+ natural voices.
Do I need video production experience to create videos?
No. Synthesia is built for non-technical teams.
Select an AI actor, paste your script, and produce a polished video without cameras, studios, or editing software.
How are Synthesia’s AI actors created?
All Synthesia AI actors are created using real actors who provide consent and are paid per video generated using their likeness. These performances are captured and transformed into AI models that can then speak any script in 160+ languages.

FAQs
AI video dubbing FAQs
Which is the best AI dubbing tool?
Synthesia stands out as the
best tool for AI dubbing
because it offers the complete package of voice preservation, lip synchronization, and secure editing capabilities in one platform. While many tools provide basic
video translation
or subtitle generation, Synthesia maintains the original speaker's voice across all languages and ensures perfect lip sync, creating a natural viewing experience that feels authentic rather than artificially generated.
Beyond technical capabilities, Synthesia prioritizes safety and ease of use with built-in content moderation, collaborative editing features, and a multilingual video player that automatically serves content in the viewer's preferred language. This combination of advanced dubbing technology with enterprise-grade security and user-friendly design makes it particularly valuable for businesses that need to create professional multilingual content at scale while maintaining quality and brand consistency.
What is AI dubbing and how does it work?
AI dubbing is a technology that automatically translates and replaces the original audio in your videos with a new language while preserving the speaker's unique voice characteristics and syncing with their lip movements. This process transforms your content into multiple languages in minutes rather than weeks, making your videos accessible to global audiences without the traditional costs and complexity of hiring voice actors and recording studios.
Unlike traditional dubbing methods that require extensive time and resources, Synthesia’s AI dubbing maintains the authenticity of your original content by keeping the same voice tone and emotional delivery across all languages. This means your training videos, marketing content, or company updates can reach international teams and customers with the same impact as your original version, helping you expand your reach and improve engagement across different markets.
Is AI dubbing safe?
Yes, AI dubbing with Synthesia is designed with robust safety measures to protect your content and ensure ethical use. The platform implements rigorous content moderation at the point of creation, using advanced technology filters and human oversight to prevent inappropriate or harmful content from being created or distributed.
Synthesia's secure editing features ensure that any changes to translated scripts are moderated to maintain the original message's meaning and prevent misuse of anyone's likeness. With ISO 42001 certification for AI safety and full GDPR compliance, your data and content remain protected throughout the dubbing process, giving you confidence that your videos are translated responsibly while maintaining your brand's integrity.
How do I dub a video with AI in Synthesia?
Dubbing a video with Synthesia is a straightforward three-step process that takes just minutes to complete. First, you upload your existing video to the dubbing tool, where it automatically detects and preserves each speaker's voice, even in videos with multiple speakers. Next, you select your target languages from over 130 available options, and the AI generates translated versions that maintain your original voice characteristics and lip sync.
Once the translation is complete, you can review and edit the transcript to ensure accuracy while the platform's content moderation tools protect the integrity of your message. The final dubbed video can be downloaded, shared via a single link, or embedded using Synthesia's multilingual player that automatically plays in your viewer's preferred language, making global distribution seamless and professional.
What languages are supported?
Synthesia supports 130+ languages and dialects for AI dubbing, including right‑to‑left scripts and regional variants. Popular options include: English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, Russian, Chinese (Mandarin), Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hindi, Bengali, Turkish, Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian, Polish, and Swedish.
What rights and permissions do I need to dub a video with Synthesia?
To dub a video with Synthesia, you must have all necessary rights, licenses, and permissions for the content you're uploading. This means you need to own the video or have explicit permission from the copyright holder to create translated versions, including rights to any voices, images, and other content appearing in the video.
When using AI dubbing for videos featuring real people, you should have their consent to translate and distribute their likeness in other languages. Synthesia's platform includes safeguards through its content moderation system and adherence to ethical AI practices, but the responsibility for ensuring proper permissions lies with you as the content creator to maintain legal compliance and respect for all parties involved.
Is AI dubbing free?
Yes, you can try Synthesia’s AI dubbing for free. Upload a video, auto‑detect the source language, and generate translated, lip‑synced versions to experience the full workflow end to end. The free experience lets you quickly evaluate voice preservation, timing, and subtitles on your own content with no complex setup.
For higher usage and scale, paid plans unlock more languages and voices, advanced editing controls, collaboration, and publishing options like smart links. These plans give teams the capacity and enterprise features needed to roll out multilingual content across campaigns, training, and product docs with confidence.
Which file formats and platforms are supported?
Synthesia’s AI Dubbing works in your web browser, no software to install. You can upload videos in MP4, MOV, or WebM.

Picture this: you're halfway through a routine task when suddenly something goes wrong. An injury occurs. Equipment gets damaged. And in that moment, you realize it could have been prevented. The truth is, most workplace accidents aren't caused by bad luck—they're caused by skipping one simple step that takes less than five seconds.

That step is the ""Stop. Think. Act."" method, and it's your most effective defense against workplace incidents. This isn't complicated theory. It's a practical framework that gives you control over your safety in any situation.

Let's break down each component. When we say Stop, we mean physically pause before starting any task. This interruption is powerful because it breaks the autopilot mode we all slip into during familiar work. Whether you're lifting equipment, entering a confined space, or operating machinery, that momentary pause creates the space you need for awareness.

The Think phase is where you conduct a rapid risk assessment. What hazards exist in this environment? Do I have the proper training and equipment for this task? Are there environmental factors like wet floors, poor lighting, or nearby hazards? Is there a safer way to accomplish this? These questions take seconds to answer but can prevent hours of consequences.

Now comes Act—the decision point. Based on your assessment, you take the appropriate action. This might mean securing your safety equipment, requesting assistance, modifying your approach, or recognizing that conditions aren't safe to proceed. Acting deliberately means you're in command of the situation, not reacting to it.

Starting today, commit to this method. Before every task, give yourself those five seconds. Encourage your team to do the same. When this becomes standard practice, we transform our workplace into an environment where everyone returns home safely. Make ""Stop. Think. Act."" your professional standard.
compliance-training-bold
What if I told you that five seconds could be the difference between going home safe and ending up in the emergency room? Every workplace accident you've ever heard of had one thing in common: someone skipped a crucial step right before everything went wrong.
Here's the truth. You're not invincible, and neither is anyone on your team. But you do have a weapon that beats every hazard out there. It's called Stop. Think. Act., and mastering this method will make you untouchable when it comes to preventable accidents.
STOP means you physically halt before any task. I'm talking full freeze. Doesn't matter if you're running late, doesn't matter if your supervisor is watching, doesn't matter if you've done this exact job ten thousand times. You stop. No exceptions. This isn't a suggestion, it's your first line of defense.
THINK is where you become a detective. Scan everything. What's the worst thing that could happen right now? Do you have the correct protective gear? Is your environment secure? Are there people nearby who could get hurt? Run through the entire sequence in your mind like you're watching a movie. Spot the dangers before they spot you.
ACT with precision and purpose. Execute each movement deliberately. Follow every protocol. Stay sharp, stay focused, stay in control. You're not sleepwalking through this task anymore. You're a professional who values their life and the lives of others.
Starting right now, Stop. Think. Act. becomes non-negotiable in everything you do. Drill it into your routine. Teach it to everyone around you. Turn it into the standard that nobody breaks. Your future self will thank you for it.
compliance-training-casual
Picture this: you're halfway through a routine task when suddenly—boom—something goes wrong. Maybe it's a close call, maybe it's worse. And the crazy part? Most workplace accidents happen during tasks people have done a hundred times before. So what if I told you there's a dead-simple method that takes ten seconds and could literally save your life?
It's called "Stop. Think. Act." and I promise you, this isn't some corporate buzzword nonsense. This actually works. Here's how it breaks down.
First, Stop. Before you dive into any task, just hit pause for a second. I get it, you're in the zone, you've got deadlines breathing down your neck. But this quick moment breaks you out of autopilot mode. Whether you're climbing a ladder, operating equipment, or handling materials, that one-second pause can make all the difference.
Now, Think. This is where you become your own safety inspector. Ask yourself: what could go wrong right now? Do I have the right protective gear? Is my workspace clear? Are there any hazards I'm missing? Run through the steps in your head. If something feels sketchy or you're unsure, don't ignore that feeling. Your gut is usually right.
Finally, Act. Go ahead and do the task, but now you're doing it with your eyes wide open. You've spotted the risks, you've got your safety measures locked in, and you're executing it the right way. Not the fastest way, not the corner-cutting way—the safe way.
Ten seconds. That's all "Stop. Think. Act." takes. But those ten seconds can prevent injuries that change everything. So starting today, make this your new habit before every single task. Your body will thank you.
compliance-training-friendly
Picture this: you're halfway through lifting a heavy box when you realize your grip isn't quite right, but you keep going anyway because, hey, you're almost done. We've all cut corners like this, thinking nothing bad will happen. Until it does.
Let me share something that takes just seconds but could literally save you from serious injury. It's called the Stop. Think. Act. method, and once you start using it, you'll wonder how you ever worked without it.
Here's how it works. First, Stop. I mean really stop what you're doing, even if you're in the middle of a task. Yes, even when you're busy. Especially when you're busy, because that's when mistakes happen. Stopping gives your mind a moment to catch up with your body, and that moment matters more than you might think.
Now, Think. Ask yourself a few quick questions. What could go wrong right now? Do I have the proper equipment? Is my environment safe? Am I rushing? Sometimes we're so focused on getting things done that we miss obvious warning signs. Thinking lets you spot those hazards before they spot you.
Finally, Act. You've paused, you've assessed the situation, and now you can move forward safely. You're not just reacting anymore. You're making smart, deliberate choices that protect you and everyone around you.
The real magic happens when this becomes second nature. You'll start doing it automatically, and your coworkers will notice. Safety is contagious in the best possible way.
Starting right now, commit to using Stop. Think. Act. every single day. Make it your safety superpower. Your body, your family, and your team are all counting on you to get home safe. Let's make that happen together.

Picture this: two companies lose their top performer in the same week. One scrambles to offer counter-offers and perks. The other barely notices a ripple because they've built a culture where talent thrives at every level. The difference? One thinks tactically. The other thinks strategically.
Let's be clear on what separates these two approaches. Tactical thinking operates in the moment. It's the emergency response when engagement scores drop or turnover spikes. You implement recognition programs, organize team events, offer incentives. These actions can produce results, and sometimes they're exactly what you need. But they're reactive by nature. You're treating the fever without diagnosing the illness.
Strategic thinking digs deeper. It examines why people connect with their work in the first place. It looks at career pathways, psychological safety, autonomy, and purpose. Strategic leaders design systems that make engagement inevitable rather than accidental. They measure leading indicators, not just outcomes. They invest in manager capability because they understand that people don't leave companies; they leave leaders. This approach requires patience, resources, and conviction, but it compounds over time.
Here's what matters most: tactical and strategic thinking aren't enemies. The best organizations use tactical interventions to reinforce strategic foundations. That team celebration isn't just a morale boost; it's a deliberate touchpoint in a broader culture of recognition. The quarterly survey isn't just data collection; it's part of an ongoing dialogue that shapes policy.
Your employees can sense whether you're applying band-aids or building something meaningful. They know the difference between being managed and being valued. Take an honest look at your current approach. Are you reacting to problems, or are you preventing them? That answer will determine whether you're simply retaining people or truly engaging them for the long term.
employee-development-bold
You think you're engaging your team, but you're actually just keeping them quiet. And there's a world of difference between the two.
Most leaders are playing checkers when they should be playing chess. They're stuck in tactical mode, throwing surface-level solutions at deep-rooted problems. Free coffee in the break room. Team building exercises that everyone tolerates but nobody enjoys. Recognition programs that feel hollow because the underlying culture is rotten. These are tactics. They're noise. They create the illusion of progress while your best people are already updating their resumes.
Strategic thinking cuts through all that nonsense. It forces you to confront uncomfortable realities. Why do talented people leave after eighteen months? Why do your meetings feel like time theft? Why does innovation die in committee? Strategic leaders don't paper over these cracks. They rebuild the foundation.
When you shift to strategic engagement, everything changes. You're not bribing people to care. You're removing the barriers that prevent them from caring in the first place. You're creating clear paths for growth, not just vague promises. You're giving people real decision-making power, not just the appearance of input. You're connecting daily work to meaningful outcomes, so everyone understands why they matter.
This isn't soft skills territory. This is competitive advantage. Companies with strategically engaged workforces don't just retain talent. They attract it. They innovate faster. They execute better. They win.
The question isn't whether you can afford to think strategically. It's whether you can afford not to. Stop managing morale and start engineering commitment. Your move.
employee-development-casual
You ever notice how some people at work seem genuinely pumped to be there, while others look like they're serving a life sentence? The difference isn't the job. It's whether they're thinking like a chess player or just moving pieces around the board.

Tactical thinkers are asking "What needs to happen today?" They're focused on execution, on the immediate tasks. And look, this matters. Nothing gets done without tactical thinking. But if your entire team is stuck here, they're basically human to-do lists. And nobody wakes up excited to be a to-do list.
Strategic thinking is different. It's lifting your head up and seeing the whole landscape. Strategic thinkers ask "Where are we going?" and "Why are we doing this?" They connect their work to outcomes that actually matter. They see how their piece fits into the puzzle.
Here's the thing with employee engagement: you need both working together. Imagine someone on your team handles customer complaints. Tactically, they're just closing tickets. But strategically, they're protecting your reputation, learning what customers really need, and feeding insights that shape your entire product. Same job, completely different experience.
When your people understand both levels, everything shifts. They're not just completing tasks, they're contributing to something real. They feel ownership. They bring ideas. They actually care.
So here's your move: pick one person on your team this week. Show them the strategic why behind their tactical what. Have that conversation. You might be surprised how quickly engagement stops being a problem and starts being your biggest advantage.
employee-development-friendly
You know what nobody tells you when you step into leadership? That the way you think will completely transform how your team shows up to work every single day.
Let me paint you a picture. Tactical thinking is when you're managing the immediate stuff. You're organizing schedules, solving today's problems, making sure deadlines get met. It's essential, don't get me wrong. But here's what happens when that's all you do: your team starts operating on autopilot. They clock in, complete their tasks, clock out. Think of it this way: tactical thinking tells your team what to do and how to do it. Strategic thinking tells them why they're doing it. And that why? It's fuel. People don't just want to complete tasks, they want to contribute to something that means something.
The best leaders dance between both. You need tactical skills to keep operations smooth and productive. But you need strategic vision to light that spark in your people. Tactics keep today running. Strategy gives everyone a reason to be excited for tomorrow.
If engagement feels low on your team, here's your challenge: start weaving more strategic context into your conversations. Share the vision, connect the dots, help them see their impact.
Now go have that conversation with your team. They're ready to hear it, and you're ready to lead differently.

Cyber threats are evolving every single day, and your password alone is no longer enough to protect your company account. That's why we're implementing multi-factor authentication, and I'm here to guide you through the setup process step by step.
Multi-factor authentication provides a critical second layer of defense. Even if your password is compromised, unauthorized users cannot access your account without that additional verification. This protects not only your personal data but also sensitive company information and client records.
Let's walk through the setup together. Begin by logging into your company portal with your current username and password. Once logged in, locate the settings menu in the upper right corner of your screen. Click on your profile icon, then select "Account Settings" from the dropdown options.
In the Account Settings interface, find the "Security" tab on the left sidebar and click it. You'll see an option for "Multi-Factor Authentication." Click the "Enable" button to begin the setup process.
The system will ask you to choose your verification method. You have two primary options: a mobile authenticator app or text message codes. For optimal security and reliability, we strongly recommend using an authenticator app such as Microsoft Authenticator or Google Authenticator.
When you select the authenticator app option, a QR code appears on your screen. Open your chosen authenticator app on your smartphone and tap "Add Account" or the plus icon. Point your phone's camera at the QR code to scan it. The app will immediately begin generating six-digit codes that refresh every thirty seconds.
Enter the current six-digit code displayed in your app into the verification field on your computer, then click "Verify and Complete."
Your account is now secured with multi-factor authentication. Every future login will require both your password and a fresh code from your authenticator app.
Don't delay this essential security upgrade. Complete your setup today, and if you need assistance, our IT support team is ready to help.
technical-training-bold
Your company account is a gateway to everything. Customer data, financial records, confidential projects. Right now, it's protected by one password, and that's not enough. Today, you're locking it down with multi-factor authentication, and you're doing it in the next five minutes.
Pull up your company portal and log in with your username and password. Once you're inside, head straight to your account settings. You'll find a security tab waiting for you on the left side. Click it without hesitation.
Scan the page for "Multi-Factor Authentication" or "Two-Step Verification." When you spot it, hit enable. No excuses. The system will present you with verification methods. Choose an authenticator app. Not SMS. Not email for your primary method. An authenticator app like Microsoft Authenticator or Google Authenticator gives you the strongest protection. Download it right now if it's not already on your phone.
Your screen will display a QR code. Open your authenticator app and scan it. Within seconds, a six-digit code appears. Enter that code into the verification field on your computer screen. You've just linked your account to your device.
The system will demand a backup verification method. This is critical. Select your mobile number or a backup email address. Verify it immediately by entering the code sent to you. If the system provides backup codes, screenshot them or write them down. Store them somewhere safe and separate from your phone. These codes are your emergency access when everything else fails.
Now comes the moment of truth. Log out completely. Log back in. You'll be asked for your password, then your authentication code. Pull up your authenticator app, enter the code, and watch as you gain access to a properly secured account.
Don't stop here. Enable multi-factor authentication on every work account you have. Make yourself an impossible target.
technical-training-casual
Look, I'm going to be real with you. If someone gets your password, they can access everything. Your emails, company files, client data, all of it. But there's one simple thing you can do right now that makes it nearly impossible for hackers to break in, even if they have your password. Let me show you how to set up multi-factor authentication in the next few minutes.
Alright, first step. Log into your company portal with your usual credentials. Once you're in, spot that settings icon in the top right corner? It might look like a gear or three dots. Click it, and a menu drops down. Look for "Security Settings" or "Account Security" and select that.
You'll land on a page with different security options. Find the section for "Multi-Factor Authentication" or "Two-Step Verification." There should be an enable button sitting right there. Click it.
Now the system asks how you want to receive your codes. You can choose text message, email, or an authenticator app. Here's my suggestion: go with the authenticator app. It's faster, more reliable, and works without internet or cell signal. Apps like Microsoft Authenticator or Google Authenticator are free and super easy to use.
When you select the app option, a QR code appears on your screen. Grab your phone, open your authenticator app, tap the plus icon, and scan that code. Done. The app immediately starts generating fresh six-digit codes every thirty seconds.
Type the current code from your app into the box on your screen and hit confirm. That's it. You're protected.
From this moment forward, logging in means your password plus that code. Two barriers instead of one. Take five minutes today and turn this on. Your future self will thank you.
technical-training-friendly
Picture this: someone gets hold of your password right now. Without multi-factor authentication, they'd walk straight into your account like they own the place. Let's make sure that never happens. I'm going to walk you through setting up an extra layer of security that takes just minutes but protects you forever.
Alright, start by logging into your company account with your username and password. Once you're in, head over to your settings—you'll typically find this by clicking your profile picture or the gear icon in the top right corner. From there, navigate to the security section. Different systems have different layouts, but you're searching for anything labeled "Security," "Account Settings," or "Privacy."
Perfect! Now look for "Multi-Factor Authentication" or "Two-Factor Authentication." You might see it shortened to MFA or 2FA. Click to enable it, and you'll be asked how you want to receive your verification codes. You've got options here—text message, phone call, or an authenticator app. I strongly recommend using an authenticator app because it's faster, more reliable, and works anywhere.
If you go with the app, download Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator from your app store if you haven't already. Back on your computer, you'll see a QR code displayed on screen. Open your authenticator app and tap the plus sign to add a new account. Point your phone camera at that QR code, and watch the magic happen. Your account appears instantly with a six-digit code.
Type that code into the verification box on your screen. The system will confirm everything's connected. Before you finish, save any backup codes that appear—store them in a secure place like a password manager or locked file.
There you go! Your account now has a security guard that never sleeps. Take a moment to enable this on all your other company accounts while you're at it. Your data deserves this level of protection, and so do you.

Frequently asked questions
Can I download my custom AI voice from Synthesia?
Yes, you can. After creating videos in Synthesia using your cloned voice, you can download the audio file and use it in any other editing software or tool.
In which languages can my cloned voice speak?
Your cloned voice can speak in the following languages: English, Hindi, Portuguese, Chinese, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Arabic, Russian, Korean, Indonesian, Italian, Dutch, Turkish, Polish, Swedish, Filipino, Malay, Romanian, Ukrainian, Greek, Czech, Danish, Finnish, Bulgarian, Croatian, Slovak, and Tamil. We are continually working to expand this list with more languages in the near future.
What are the requirements for my custom AI voice recording to ensure a high-quality AI voice copy?
For optimal voice cloning, we recommend recording your voice in a quiet room using a good quality microphone. Better recorded audio will result in the highest possible end quality for your cloned voice.
How will my voice sound in other languages?
Your cloned voice will retain some of the unique characteristics of the original speaker, though it may not completely preserve your accent. For example, a German speaker's cloned English voice might have a slight German accent but could sound more American than the actual speaker.
How does AI voice cloning work?
AI voice cloning uses advanced artificial intelligence to create a synthetic copy of an individual’s voice. This process involves multiple steps, primarily utilizing machine learning algorithms to replicate the distinctive features of the original voice.
Can I clone any voice?
Synthesia strictly prohibits cloning voices without explicit consent. We only allow the cloning of your own voice and require users to provide verbal consent during the voice cloning process.
How can I clone my voice with Synthesia?
To clone your voice, you'll need a Synthesia Enterprise Plan account.
Within your account, navigate to the “Voices” tab and click “New Voice.” You'll then name your voice, select the language and gender, and read a few paragraphs of text followed by providing your voice cloning consent.
Once the recording is complete, we will generate your cloned voice within a few minutes and notify you via email when it’s ready for preview and use.
Can I re-record my voice if I don’t like the end result?
Yes, you can delete any previously cloned voices and create new ones. Additionally, you might want to have multiple voices to convey different emotions, such as cheerful, sad, or narration styles.

What is an AI voice generator?
An AI voice generator is a tool that turns written text into natural-sounding speech using artificial intelligence. Instead of recording audio manually, you can generate voiceovers instantly in different languages, accents, and tones.
How does an AI voice generator work?
AI voice generators use advanced text-to-speech (TTS) models trained on human speech. You input your script, choose a voice, and the
AI converts your text into realistic audio
, capturing pronunciation, pacing, and tone automatically.
How do I create an AI voiceover?
Type or paste your text into the editor, choose your AI voice, and generate your audio in seconds. Download your file and use it anywhere you need.
Is Synthesia’s AI voice generator free to use?
Yes, you can try Synthesia’s AI voice generator for free. Paid plans unlock additional features like more voices, longer scripts, and advanced customization options.
Can I use the audio generated by Synthesia’s AI voice generator for commercial purposes?
Yes, you can use the generated audio for commercial purposes, including marketing, training, and content creation, as long as it complies with
Synthesia’s terms of service
.
How do I convert my script into an AI video?
Simply
paste your script
into Synthesia, choose an AI voice and avatar, and generate your video. Your voiceover will be automatically synced with the avatar, creating a professional video in minutes.
What languages does Synthesia support?
Synthesia supports 160+ languages and accents, allowing you to create voiceovers for global audiences and localise your content easily.
Can I make an AI of my own voice?
Yes! You can create your own AI voice using Synthesia’s built-in
voice cloning feature
. Your voice will appear in your account and can be used across videos and voiceovers, helping you create content that sounds uniquely like you at scale.

Frequently asked questions about AI avatars
What is an AI avatar and how does it work?
An AI avatar is a realistic digital human, generated by artificial intelligence, that can present any script on screen without a camera, studio, or filming session.
Synthesia's stock avatars are built from footage of real actors who give their explicit consent and are paid each time their avatar is used. That footage trains an AI model, which learns the person's appearance, movement, and facial structure in detail. When you create a video, the AI generates new lip-sync, expressions, and body language to match your script, powered by Synthesia's Express technology. A voice from the 1,000+ library is layered on top, in any of 160+ languages.
Personal avatars work the same way but start with you: upload a photo or a short video, and Synthesia builds a digital twin from your own likeness and cloned voice.
Can I create an AI avatar video for free?
Yes. Synthesia's free plan gives you access to stock and customizable avatars, the core editor, and video generation in 160+ languages, with no credit card required. With customizable avatars on the free plan, you can prompt outfits, environments, and on-screen actions and generate AI-powered scenes with Veo 3.
Which is the best AI avatar generator?
Synthesia is the best AI avatar generator
according to G2
. The platform is trusted by 90% of Fortune 100 companies and 1M+ users, with over 20M avatar videos generated.
Compared to other AI avatar generators, Synthesia combines the most advanced avatar technology with an interface anyone can use from day one, enterprise-grade security, and a free plan to get started without a credit card.
What type of avatar is right for me?
It depends on your use case and how much you want the avatar to represent you or your brand.
Stock avatars
are the easiest starting point. Choose from 240+ ready-made avatars and start creating immediately, with no setup required. Best for teams who want to produce video content quickly without any configuration.
Customizable avatars
are ideal if you need the avatar to reflect a specific role, industry, or brand. Describe the outfit, setting, and actions in natural language and Veo 3 generates the scene. Best for creative, scene-based, or heavily branded visual content.
Personal avatars
are the right choice if you want video content that looks and sounds like you, without being on camera. Create your avatar from a single photo and optionally clone your voice. Best for individuals who communicate regularly and want to scale their presence across training, comms, or marketing.
Studio avatars
are for organizations that need the highest level of realism. Work with our team in a professional studio session to capture your likeness in full detail. Best for executives, spokespeople, and enterprise teams where on-screen presence and credibility matter most.
Can I customize AI avatars with my own branding, outfits, and style?
Yes, extensively. With customizable avatars, you prompt the outfit, setting, and on-screen actions in natural language and Veo 3 generates the scene. That includes industry-specific clothing like uniforms, hard hats, safety glasses, or lanyards, as well as branded outfits featuring your company colors and logo.
Apply your Brand Kit to layer logos, colors, and other assets across every video automatically.
Are AI avatars safe to use?
Yes, with multiple layers of protection built in. Every video goes through content moderation before delivery. Personal avatars require a live on-camera consent verification that cannot be uploaded or bypassed: the person shown in the consent video must match the person in the avatar footage, and they must be at least 18 years of age.
Synthesia is SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, and GDPR compliant, with a dedicated Trust and Safety team. The platform is also a member of the Content Authenticity Initiative, and avatar owners can request deletion of their data at any time.
Can I make these AI avatars say anything?
Synthesia's
AI video generator
is used for business purposes with strict content moderation. We ask all our users to keep scripts professional and business related. Political, sexual, personal, criminal and discriminatory content won't be allowed.
Can I create an AI avatar of a colleague or team member?
Yes, through Synthesia's Personal Avatar Requests feature, available on Enterprise plans. You send the person a unique link by email, they complete the recording and live consent verification themselves, and the avatar is created on your account. The person does not need their own Synthesia account to complete the process.
The consent video must always be recorded live. You cannot upload a pre-recorded consent clip on someone else's behalf, and the person shown in the consent video must be the same individual as in the avatar footage. Once created, avatars and voices can be shared across your workspace on Enterprise plans.
What voices do the AI avatars have?
Synthesia includes 1,000+ AI voices across 160+ languages and accents, available across our avatar library. Some voices include multiple emotional styles, so you can match tone to content, whether that is a calm instructional delivery or a more energetic announcement. Specific avatars including Ellie, Michael, and Zola offer multiple voice styles, paired with script-synced body language. If you create a Personal Avatar, you can also record a voice sample to
clone your own voice
.
Do I need video editing experience to create AI avatar videos?
No. Synthesia is designed for people who have never made an avatar video before. You can start from a document, a prompt, a PowerPoint, or a blank canvas, and the AI generates the script, picks the scenes, and produces a finished avatar video with lip-sync and voice included.
If you want to go further, the editor lets you add animations, images, music, captions, motion graphics, interactivity, and more, but none of that requires technical skills. Most users create their first AI avatar video within minutes of signing up.

Frequently asked questions
How do the voices work?
Synthesia uses a technology called text-to-speech to read your typed text aloud. With Synthesia you can then go one step further by matching an AI avatar’s face to that voice, to enjoy both hearing and seeing your text come to life.
Do all of the voices sound the same?
No, Synthesia has a large selection of languages that come with varied accents, dialects and styles. This versatility enables you to create content suitable for a wide range of purposes.
How dynamic are the voices?
Synthesia’s voices sound almost as natural as real human voices and can handle nuanced pronunciation, abbreviation and terminology. With an in-built option for phonetic spelling, it is easy to adjust the pronunciation of any word inside Synthesia.
Does Synthesia translate text for me?
Yes, Synthesia now has a 1-Click Translation option (Enterprise accounts). You can simply select which languages you'd like your video to be localized in and Synthesia translates both the script and canvas elements in a few seconds.
Can I upload a voice recording?
If you’re on an Enterprise plan you can upload a voice recording to use within Synthesia. The avatar will then lip sync with your voice recording. Find out more about voice uploads
here
.
Can I clone my own voice?
Create a high-quality copy of your voice with Synthesia and use it in 29 languages.
Voice cloning
as a separate feature is available only for Enterprise users. However, if you are on the Starter or Creator plan, you can create your
personal avatar
, and Synthesia will automatically generate a copy of your voice as well.
Is my language available or coming soon?
With over 160+ languages and accents we already cater for a diverse range of cultures. However, we’re constantly looking to expand our range. So, if your language is not yet available, it is likely to be added soon.
Can I add closed captions?
When generating your video you will be asked whether you’d like to add closed captions. Closed captions will be generated in the language that the text was narrated in.

What makes Synthesia the best AI tool for text to video?
Synthesia is the

Is Synthesia free to use for text to video?
Yes. The free plan lets you generate up to 10 minutes of video per month with access to a range of AI avatars and voiceovers in 160+ languages. Free videos include the Synthesia logo. To remove it and unlock downloads, custom avatars, and Brand Kit, you'll need a paid plan.
How long does it take to generate a video from text?
Most videos are ready within 2 to 5 minutes of hitting generate. Length and complexity affect the time, but there is no lengthy rendering queue. You can edit and regenerate as many times as you need before exporting.
How is Synthesia different from Sora or Veo?
Synthesia includes both. Sora 2 and Veo 3 are built directly into the platform, so you can generate cinematic b-roll and visual assets from a text prompt without leaving the editor. Alongside that, Synthesia's
AI avatars
give you a consistent human presenter for training, explainers, and business comms. The result is a complete video, not just a generative clip, with everything produced in one place.
What languages does Synthesia support for text to video?
Synthesia supports 160+ languages with built-in
AI voices
, so you can create a video in one language and
translate
it into others without re-recording. The platform includes a multilingual player that lets viewers select their preferred language directly in the video.
Can I convert existing content like articles or PowerPoint slides into videos?

Is text to video AI suitable for enterprise use?
Yes. Synthesia is used by 50,000+ businesses. For enterprise teams, the platform includes Brand Kit for consistent styling, SSO, live collaboration, version control, and compliance certifications including SOC 2 Type II, ISO 42001, and GDPR.
Can I use Synthesia for commercial text to video projects?
Yes. Videos you create in Synthesia are yours to use commercially, including for marketing, client-facing training, sales materials, and customer comms. Enterprise plans include additional legal and compliance controls for teams with stricter requirements.
Can ChatGPT convert text to video?
ChatGPT generates text, not video. It can help you write or refine a script, but you need a separate tool to turn that into a finished video. Synthesia connects with ChatGPT so you can generate a script with GPT and convert it into a video in the same workflow.

of making a

depending on the tools and resources you use. With online platforms like Synthesia, you can create professional training videos for a fraction of the cost compared to traditional methods. Many platforms also offer free trials or affordable subscription plans.
How to structure training videos?
To structure a training video effectively:
Start with a clear introduction outlining the learning objectives.
Divide the content into short, logical sections for better engagement.
Use visuals, examples, and interactive elements to explain concepts.
End with a summary and a call-to-action, encouraging learners to apply what they've learned.
What is the difference between an instructional video and a training video?
An
instructional video
focuses on teaching a specific task or concept, often step-by-step, and is usually shorter and more direct. Its primary goal is to explain "how to" do something, such as assembling a product or using a software feature or
internal company too
l.
A
training video
, on the other hand, is broader in scope and designed to build skills, knowledge, or behaviors over time. It often includes a structured approach, like objectives, detailed explanations, examples, and assessments, and is part of a larger learning or development program.
In essence, instructional videos are task-focused, while training videos are more comprehensive and goal-oriented.
What are the benefits of online training vs. in-person training?
Online training offers several advantages over in-person training, including:
Flexibility:
Learners can access training anytime, anywhere, allowing them to learn at their own pace and fit it into their schedule.
Cost-Effectiveness:
Online training reduces costs associated with travel, venues, printed materials, and instructor fees.
Scalability:
It's easy to roll out training to large, geographically dispersed teams.
Consistent Content:
Ensures the same quality and messaging is delivered to all learners, regardless of location.
Interactivity and Engagement:
Many online platforms offer features like quizzes, gamification, and multimedia to keep learners engaged.
Tracking and Analytics:
Progress can be tracked in real-time, providing insights into learner performance and areas for improvement.
While in-person training allows for direct interaction and hands-on activities, online training provides greater convenience and scalability, making it ideal for many modern learning needs.

Why choose dubbing over subtitles?
Because subtitles split viewer attention, and research shows that affects engagement, immersion, and how much people retain.
Deliver learning that actually sticks
Subtitles don't always hurt immediate understanding, but
research
has found they can undermine deeper learning over time. In a randomized study of 247 undergraduates, students who watched subtitled video performed worse on transfer tasks over time than those who watched narrated video without subtitles.
Keep viewers absorbed in your content
In a
study
of 154 adults, dubbed content produced measurably higher viewer scores for spatial presence (4.19 vs. 3.80), flow (3.68 vs. 3.35), and transportation than subtitled content, three established indicators of how absorbed a viewer is in what they are watching.
Reduce cognitive effort for complex topics
Research
found that for complex audiovisual content, subtitling leads to more effortful processing and lower cognitive performance than dubbing. For training, technical, and product video, that extra cognitive load is resource that is not going into the content itself.

FAQs
All your video translation questions answered
What is the best video translation tool?
Synthesia is widely considered the
best AI video translation tool
for business use. Where most tools stop at subtitle generation, Synthesia produces fully dubbed video. Voice cloning preserves each speaker's identity, lip-sync keeps visuals matched to speech, and subtitles generate automatically alongside every dubbed version.
The built-in transcript editor lets you refine translations, tune pronunciation, and adapt terminology before publishing. For teams working at scale, Synthesia also offers secure editing controls, live collaboration, and analytics to track how each translated video performs across markets. A single smart link serves each viewer their language automatically, with no need to manage separate video files per market.
Is Synthesia's video translator free?
Yes, the AI video translator is free to use. Sign up without a payment method and you can run the complete translation workflow on your own content, from upload through to a dubbed, lip-synced output you can review and download.
The free plan is designed to give you a genuine read on translation quality before committing to anything. Teams producing content at scale, or needing features like version control, team collaboration, and smart link publishing, can explore paid plans.
How many languages can I translate my video into?
Synthesia supports 130+ languages, including English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Mandarin Chinese, Hindi, Arabic, Turkish, Russian, Polish, Indonesian, Thai, and Vietnamese, among others. Many languages include regional accent options, so you can target British or American English, Latin American or Castilian Spanish, and so on, rather than defaulting to a generic regional variant.
You can select multiple target languages in a single translation job and generate all versions simultaneously. Synthesia also auto-detects the source language of your video on upload, so you do not need to specify it manually.
Can I translate a YouTube video?
Yes. Paste your video’s public YouTube URL into the translator and Synthesia pulls the video and transcribes the audio automatically. You then select your target languages and generate dubbed versions exactly as you would with an uploaded file. This is particularly useful for repurposing existing published content such as webinars,
product demos
, and recorded training sessions, without needing to track down the original source file.
Can AI keep my original voice when translating into another language?
Yes. By default, Synthesia's
voice cloning
captures tone, timbre, pacing, and speaking style from the source audio and applies those characteristics to the dubbed version in each target language. For videos with multiple speakers, the system detects and preserves each voice independently, so a two-person interview or panel discussion maintains the distinction between speakers across all language versions. Source audio quality affects clone accuracy, so cleaner recordings tend to produce more reliable results. You can also replace any speaker's voice with a stock or custom cloned voice if needed.
How long does it take to translate and generate a lip-synced video with Synthesia?
Most videos are ready to review within minutes of upload. All target languages are processed in parallel, so translating into 10 languages does not take 10 times as long as a single-language dub. Video length is the main factor affecting processing time. Traditional dubbing involves script translation, casting, studio booking, recording, and post-production sync, a process that typically takes days to weeks per language. Synthesia handles all of that in a single automated pipeline.
How accurate is the AI dubbing and lip-sync, and will it look natural to native speakers?
One technical challenge in any dubbing system is that languages expand and contract significantly in translation. A 10-word English sentence might become 7 words in Japanese or 14 in German.
Synthesia offers two ways to handle this: Adaptive mode, which adjusts speech speed to fit the original video timing naturally, and Original mode, which maintains the original playback speed and lets the translated audio run at its natural length. Where the result does not sound natural, the transcript editor lets you adjust individual phrases and regenerate the lip-sync for that segment only. Proper nouns, fast speech, and heavy accents in the source are the most common cases where manual refinement helps.
Can I review and edit the transcript or translation before exporting?
Yes. Reviewing and editing the transcript before generating the dub does not consume any credits. The editor gives you independent access to the transcript for every language version, and edits to one language do not affect the others.
You can correct mistranslations, localize terminology, fix the pronunciation of product names and technical terms, adjust pacing for individual phrases, and replace speaker voices with stock or custom cloned voices. When you save a change after generation, the audio and lip-sync for that version regenerate automatically. This matters most for regulated industries or technical training content where terminology accuracy is non-negotiable.
Do I need existing subtitles to translate a video?
No. Synthesia transcribes your video automatically on upload. If anything needs correcting before translation begins, such as a product name, a technical abbreviation, or a regional term, edit the transcript first and the corrected version becomes the basis for all target language translations.
If you already have an approved transcript or subtitle file you want to use, upload it manually to override the automatic transcription. This is especially useful when source audio quality is poor or the video contains dense technical language that benefits from a pre-approved script.
How do I download or share my translated videos?
Download individual translated video versions as MP4 files, or download subtitles as SRT files per language, which is useful for uploading to YouTube, an LMS, or any platform that handles video distribution separately.
For direct sharing, a single smart link detects each viewer's browser language and serves the matching dubbed version automatically, with a manual language selector for anyone who wants to switch. To embed on a website, Synthesia's multilingual player hosts all language versions under one embed code, so you do not need separate embeds per market or to update the page when you add new language versions.

Synthesia a été fondée en 2017 par une équipe d'entrepreneurs et de chercheurs spécialisés en IA issus de l'UCL, Stanford, TUM et Cambridge. Notre mission consiste à aider les gens à mieux travailler, en transformant la manière dont les organisations forment, intègrent et font monter en compétences leurs employés grâce à l'IA.
ethique
Toujours engagés pour l'éthique de l'IA
À mesure que l'impact de l'IA ne cesse de croître, notre position est claire : l'humain passe avant tout.
Pour concrétiser cet engagement, 10% de notre équipe se consacre à la sécurité et à l'éthique de l'IA.
En savoir plus
recherche en IA
Rendre la vidéo accessible à tous
Chez Synthesia, une équipe de chercheurs et d'ingénieurs d'excellence s'engage à développer la technologie nécessaire pour faire évoluer notre plateforme vidéo IA actuelle. Notre objectif : enrichir la communication visuelle grâce aux avatars et aux agents et à des outils de développement des compétences.

Texte secondaire
MISSION
Notre mission est de rendre la vidéo accessible à tous
Nous cherchons à augmenter les capacités humaines, jamais à les remplacer. Nous valorisons les compétences et les qualités humaines et nous nous assurons que notre technologie vient les compléter, sans jamais les concurrencer.
ÉTHIQUE
Utilisation éthique de l'IA
Depuis 2017, nous sommes à la pointe des avancées en matière d'IA générative. L’éthique et la sécurité de l’IA font partie intégrante de notre mission et, pour traduire nos engagements en actes, nous nous appuyons sur la règle des 3C :
Consentement, Contrôle et Collaboration.
Voici comment cette approche guide notre prise de décision :
Consentement
Nous respectons votre droit à l'image. C'est à vous de décider comment l'utiliser. Nous ne créerons donc jamais un avatar IA sans votre consentement explicite, de même que nous ne permettons pas non plus l'utilisation de l'image d'hommes politiques ou de célébrités à des fins satiriques. Pas d'usurpations d'identité, pas de zones grises.
Voici comment nous procédons :
Avatars libres de droits
Avatars personnalisés
De vraies personnes, un consentement réel
: nos avatars IA ont été créés à partir de performances de véritables acteurs humains, avec leur consentement explicite.
Des règles claires
: les acteurs reçoivent des informations claires et transparentes sur la façon dont leur image sera utilisée et sont justement rémunérés pour leur participation.
Retrait du consentement
: nos acteurs peuvent exercer leur droit de retrait. Nous respectons cette décision afin de garantir une transition en douceur.
Votre image, votre accord
: votre avatar ne peut être créé qu'avec votre consentement explicite, après une procédure KYC approfondie.
Contrôle total
: notre plateforme vous permet de décider qui utilise votre avatar, quand et comment. Personne ne peut y accéder sans votre consentement explicite.
Retrait du consentement
: vous pouvez exercer votre droit de retrait. Toutes vos données et votre image seront alors définitivement supprimées de nos bases de données.
Onglet 1
Onglet 2
Contrôle
Notre plateforme est plus qu'un simple outil. Elle offre un environnement sécurisé aux entreprises, vous garantissant que vos données personnelles et celles de votre société sont protégées et restent sous votre contrôle.
Voici les mesures que nous mettons en place pour que vous ayez toujours la main :
Politique de modération de contenu
: nous mettons en œuvre une modération rigoureuse au moment de la création des contenus, en utilisant des filtres technologiques avancés et une surveillance humaine pour empêcher tout contenu inapproprié ou préjudiciable.
En savoir plus
Équipe de sécurité
: notre équipe dédiée travaille 24h/24 et 7j/7 pour sécuriser notre plateforme et s'assurer qu'elle est utilisée de manière responsable.
Accès personnalisé
: nous avons conçu des rôles utilisateur pour créer des accès personnalisés, afin que notre outil profite à tous, tout en réservant l'accès aux informations sensibles aux seules personnes autorisées.
Votre image, votre accord
: votre avatar ne peut être créé qu'avec votre consentement explicite, après une procédure KYC approfondie.
Contrôle total
: notre plateforme vous permet de décider qui utilise votre avatar, quand et comment. Personne ne peut y accéder sans votre consentement explicite.
Retrait du consentement
: vous pouvez exercer votre droit de retrait. Toutes vos données et votre image seront alors définitivement supprimées de nos bases de données.
Collaboration
Relever les défis de l'IA est un travail d'équipe. Nous croyons fermement à la nécessité d'unir nos forces avec les leaders de l'industrie et les organismes de régulation.
Nos efforts de collaboration se traduisent notamment par
:
Notre engagement avec les organismes de réglementation
: nous coopérons activement avec les organismes de réglementation et nous sommes favorables à l'élaboration de politiques et de réglementations rigoureuses en matière d’IA.
Notre adhésion au Partenariat sur l'IA (PAI) :
nous sommes partenaires de lancement du Partenariat sur l’IA (PAI) dans le domaine des pratiques responsables pour les médias générés par l'IA. Il s'agit du premier cadre sectoriel pour le développement, la création et le partage éthiques et responsables de médias générés par l’IA.
En savoir plus
Notre participation à l'Initiative d'authenticité de contenu
: nous sommes membres actifs de l'Initiative d'authenticité de contenu, aux côtés d'entreprises leaders du secteur comme Adobe, Nvidia et Microsoft.

Un conseil réunissant des experts
Le Conseil sur l'avenir de l'IA
Le Conseil sur l'avenir de l'IA est un groupe d'experts triés sur le volet, spécialisés en politique, dans les médias, en développement de produits ou en stratégie d'entreprise, qui façonnent directement l'avenir de l'IA générative. Le Conseil offre un espace de collaboration et d'échanges sur certains des enjeux les plus complexes et cruciaux liés à cette technologie transformatrice, y compris dans des domaines spécifiques à Synthesia et, plus largement, à la société.

Sophia Smith Galer est une journaliste, créatrice et autrice qui a a ouvert la voie au journalisme TikTok au Royaume-Uni. Elle a travaillé dans les domaines de la lutte contre la désinformation, le journalisme d'investigation et l'innovation IA pour aider les journalistes à rendre leur travail plus visible en ligne.

Le programme de valorisation des talents de Synthesia est une communauté qui rassemble les acteurs exceptionnels qui donnent vie à nos avatars les plus populaires. Ils donnent des retours sur notre plateforme, partagent des informations sur leur secteur et collaborent avec Synthesia sur des initiatives pour mettre en place des pratiques équitables, transparentes et durables dans notre activité. Plébiscité par les utilisateurs, validé par les équipes juridiques
Les outils d'IA sont formidables, mais ne sont pas toujours approuvés par le service de conformité. Synthesia offre la sécurité, le contrôle et la crédibilité dont votre équipe informatique a besoin pour donner son feu vert rapidement.

Synthesia gère votre flux vidéo de A à Z
La plupart des outils d'IA ne proposent que des fonctionnalités de création. Synthesia prend en charge l'ensemble du flux de travail : créez, collaborez et publiez des vidéos sur une seule plateforme sécurisée et évolutive.
Une IA centrée sur l'humain. Sans compromis, et sans ambiguïté.
Certains outils d'IA font des compromis sur l'éthique. Pas nous. Nous ne créons aucun avatar sans le consentement explicite de l'acteur, et chaque vidéo fait l'objet d'une modération stricte pour prévenir tout usage abusif.

FAQ
FAQ sur les vidéos de formation par IA
L'IA peut-elle créer des vidéos de formation ?
Oui, l'IA peut
créer des vidéos de formation professionnelles
en convertissant du texte en un contenu vidéo engageant et en intégrant des avatars IA, des voix-off et des éléments visuels. Synthesia s'affranchit des contraintes logistiques de la
production vidéo traditionnelle
: plus besoin de caméras, ni de studios, ni d'acteurs ; vous produisez des supports de grande qualité en quelques minutes seulement.
La création vidéo assistée par l'IA est particulièrement précieuse pour les équipes L&D qui doivent déployer leurs
vidéos de formation
à l'échelle mondiale. Vous pouvez créer un contenu pédagogique cohérent dans plus de 140 langues, mettre à jour vos vidéos instantanément dès qu'une information change et assurer la cohérence de votre image de marque sur tous vos supports. Cette approche aide les organisations à
réduire les coûts de formation
tout en améliorant l'engagement et la mémorisation.
Que vous produisiez des
vidéos de formation sur la conformité
, la
cybersécurité
, le
leadership
, ou des
tutoriels logiciels
, l'IA rend le processus plus rapide et plus évolutif que jamais.
Ai-je besoin de caméras, d'acteurs ou de comédiens voix-off pour créer des vidéos de formation avec Synthesia ?
Non, vous n'avez besoin d'aucun équipement de production traditionnel ni de talents externes pour créer des vidéos avec Synthesia. La plateforme utilise des avatars IA en guise de présentateurs et génère des voix-off naturelles à partir de votre texte, gérant automatiquement tous les éléments visuels et sonores.
Plus besoin de jongler avec l'emploi du temps des comédiens ou de louer des plateaux de tournage, il vous suffit de taper ou de coller votre contenu dans la plateforme. Si vous ne savez pas par où commencer, vous pouvez utiliser nos
modèles gratuits de scripts de formation
ou apprendre à
rédiger un script de vidéo de formation
qui saura captiver vos apprenants.
Ce flux de travail optimisé réduit considérablement le
coût de la formation des employés
tout en permettant aux équipes de se concentrer sur la stratégie et la conception pédagogique plutôt que sur la logistique de production.
Puis-je traduire et localiser mes vidéos de formation en plusieurs langues avec Synthesia ?
Oui, Synthesia permet la traduction et la localisation instantanées de vos vidéos dans plus de 140 langues, en un seul clic.
Cette fonctionnalité est transformatrice pour les organisations internationales qui créent des
vidéos de formation interactives
ou des
exercices de mise en situation
dans le monde entier. Le lecteur vidéo multilingue détecte automatiquement les préférences linguistiques des spectateurs, pour que chaque employé puisse suivre la formation dans sa langue préférée.
En combinant la localisation et la production IA, les entreprises peuvent déployer leurs formations à l'échelle mondiale tout en maintenant la cohérence, l'exactitude et la pertinence culturelle des contenus.
Puis-je transformer mes PDF, diapositives ou pages web existants en vidéos de formation ?
Oui, l'assistant vidéo IA de Synthesia peut
convertir automatiquement vos supports de formation en vidéos dynamiques
, y compris les PDF, les présentations PowerPoint et les pages web.
Il suffit d'importer un document ou de coller une URL : l'IA analyse le contenu pour créer un script structuré, complété par des visuels et une voix-off. Cette fonctionnalité est particulièrement utile pour les équipes souhaitant
rendre leur formation plus engageante
sans repartir de zéro.
Au lieu de devoir tout reprendre, en partant de rien, vous transformez des documents statiques en expériences d'apprentissage dynamiques qui améliorent la compréhension, la mémorisation et les taux de complétion.
Synthesia est-elle une solution sécurisée et conforme pour les contenus de formation en entreprise (SOC 2, RGPD) ?
Oui, Synthesia bénéficie de la certification SOC 2 Type II et respecte scrupuleusement le RGPD, répondant ainsi aux exigences de sécurité strictes nécessaires aux contenus de formation en entreprise. La plateforme met en œuvre des mesures de sécurité complètes pour protéger les supports de formation sensibles et les données des employés tout au long du processus de création et de diffusion.
La sécurité est intégrée à chaque aspect de la plateforme, du stockage de données chiffrées aux autorisations d'accès contrôlées pour la collaboration en équipe. Cet engagement en faveur de la protection des données permet aux équipes L&D de créer en toute confiance des vidéos contenant des informations propriétaires, des documents de conformité ou des procédures d'entreprise confidentielles. L'infrastructure de sécurité avancée garantit que votre contenu reste protégé tout en étant facilement accessible aux apprenants autorisés au sein de votre organisation.

Découvrez comment Synthesia répond aux exigences légales, d'approvisionnement et de sécurité grâce à des dispositifs de sécurité intégrés et une gouvernance clairement établie.
En savoir plus
Plus de 90 % des entreprises du Fortune 100 nous font confiance.
GOUVERNANCE DE L'IA
L’IA responsable est dans notre
ADN
Fondé sur les principes du consentement, du contrôle et de la collaboration, notre
cadre des 3C
guide nos décisions depuis 2017.
Consentement
Le consentement ne se limite pas à une simple politique. C'est une mesure de protection au niveau du système qui protège les droits des utilisateurs, maintient la confiance dans la marque et respecte les exigences mondiales en matière de confidentialité et de protection des données pour l'ensemble des déploiements.
La vidéo, la voix ou l'image d'une personne n'est jamais utilisée pour créer un avatar sans consentement explicite et documenté. Nous avons conçu la plateforme de manière à ce que ce principe soit présent à chaque étape, de la création des avatars à leur diffusion, en passant par leur utilisation.

Les données des clients ne sont jamais utilisées pour entraîner nos modèles d'IA. Les scripts, les avatars et les vidéos ne sont utilisés que conformément aux indications du client. Les avatars personnalisés restent dans l'espace de travail du client et ne sont pas partagés, réutilisés ou accessibles ailleurs.
Contrôle
La plateforme a été conçue pour garantir le contrôle, assurer une utilisation responsable de l'IA de bout en bout et aider les entreprises à respecter leurs exigences internes de gouvernance, leurs protocoles de sécurité et leurs obligations de conformité.
Les administrateurs d'espace de travail définissent qui peut créer, accéder et partager du contenu. Chaque vidéo fait l'objet d'une modération automatisée, ce qui permet de bloquer le contenu nuisible ou inapproprié avant qu'il ne soit généré.

Le contenu créé appartient toujours au client. Les scripts, les avatars et les vidéos ne sont jamais réutilisés. L'accès aux avatars est limité aux espaces de travail et encadré par des contrôles d'accès basés sur les rôles et des journaux d'audit, assurant une gestion sécurisée.
Collaboration
L'IA responsable relève d'un effort collectif. C'est une approche commune, fondée sur la collaboration, la transparence et l'alignement opérationnel, aidant les clients à réussir avec des systèmes auxquels ils peuvent faire confiance et qu'ils peuvent comprendre.
Nous travaillons avec les agences de régulation, les organismes de normalisation et les experts en politiques d'IA pour construire des systèmes qui répondent aux exigences éthiques et légales en matière de développement, de déploiement et d'innovation responsable, à grande échelle.
La contribution de nos clients est essentielle à la définition de notre feuille de route. Leurs retours guident nos fonctionnalités, nos politiques et notre documentation. Nous les accompagnons avec des formations, des audits et des outils pour répondre aux exigences des contextes de gouvernance complexes.
