faq
FAQ sur la gouvernance de l'IA.
Les données des clients sont-elles utilisées pour entraîner les modèles d'IA ?
Synthesia n'utilise pas les données de ses clients (entrées ou sorties), pour pré-entraîner ses composants d'IA. Tout traitement des données clients qui nécessite ou entraîne un ajustement des composants d'IA est effectué sur la base des instructions écrites des clients, conformément aux stipulations de leur contrat.
À qui appartiennent les vidéos créées par le service ?
Le client conserve la propriété des vidéos. Les conditions générales de service du client en fixeront les modalités.
Quels contrôles sont en place pour empêcher l'utilisation de Synthesia à des fins de création de contenu malveillant ou inapproprié ?
Synthesia a mis en place une procédure de modération élaborée pour prévenir l'utilisation abusive de la plateforme à des fins qui violeraient nos conditions générales d'utilisation.
Une fois l'abonnement terminé, qu'advient-il du modèle et des données stockées ?
L'utilisateur peut demander la suppression d'une vidéo/d'un avatar à tout moment. La suppression de ces éléments de notre système peut prendre jusqu'à 90 jours. Si, à la résiliation d'un compte, nous recevons une demande de suppression d'une partie ou de l'intégralité des données liées aux vidéos, aux avatars et aux voix, nous supprimerons toutes les copies de manière permanente et fournirons une confirmation de la suppression. Après la résiliation d'un compte, en l'absence de demande de suppression, les informations seront automatiquement supprimées dans les 90 jours.
Comment garantissez-vous l'explicabilité de la solution IA ?
Synthesia s'engage à rendre ses composants d'IA compréhensibles et explicables pour les clients et leurs utilisateurs. La transparence inhérente des services, où les sorties de l'IA sont directement liées aux entrées fournies par le client, garantit que les écarts entre les résultats attendus et réels sont immédiatement apparents. Ce lien clair entre l'entrée (scripts, voix, image) et la sortie (performance de l'avatar) offre une explication simple, permettant aux clients à la fois de faire confiance et d'interagir efficacement avec leurs systèmes, mais aussi d'anticiper les scénarios préjudiciables et d'atténuer les abus.

De plus, avec le créateur d'avatar, une nouvelle fonctionnalité réservée aux clients de nos plans professionnels, vous pouvez personnaliser les avatars en changeant leurs vêtements et en y ajoutant votre logo et vos couleurs, pour produire un contenu cohérent et percutant à chaque fois.
Est-ce que les vidéos IA s'intègrent aux plateformes LMS ?
Le générateur de vidéos IA de Synthesia a été conçu pour s'intégrer facilement à votre système de gestion de l'apprentissage (LMS) et permettre un flux de travail fluide et efficace. Vous pouvez créer des vidéos IA et les intégrer directement à vos modules de formation. Cette intégration simplifie le processus de mise à jour et de diffusion des supports de formation.
Comment la création de vidéos d'intelligence artificielle améliore-t-elle la productivité des employés ?
Les vidéos d'intelligence artificielle créées avec Synthesia permettent aux entreprises de gagner en agilité et en cohérence en matière de communication interne et de formation. Il s'agit d'un format attrayant, que vous pouvez mettre à jour, traduire et personnaliser facilement, ce qui, en fin de compte, permet non seulement de mieux informer vos collaborateurs et de renforcer leurs compétences et leur motivation, mais aussi de contribuer à la réussite des initiatives d'apprentissage et d'améliorer la productivité de l'organisation.
Découvrez d'autres fonctionnalités incroyables de Synthesia !
Que ce soit la saison des fêtes ou une autre période, nous innovons sans cesse dans la création vidéo en lançant de nouveaux outils d'IA formidables.

Annonce de notre levée de fonds en Série E
Ce tour de table de 150 millions de dollars est mené par NEA avec la participation de plusieurs fonds stratégiques, aux côtés de nos investisseurs actuels qui ont renforcé leurs positions.
En savoir plus
Lire la vidéo
Mettre en pause
Un nouveau chapitre pour Synthesia
Aujourd'hui, j'ai le plaisir de partager une excellente nouvelle : nous avons levé 200 millions de dollars dans le cadre d'un tour de table de Série E, valorisant l'entreprise à 4 milliards de dollars. C’est une étape majeure pour nous et, plus important encore, cela marque le début du prochain chapitre de Synthesia.
Que ferons-nous avec ce nouveau capital ?
En un mot, nous allons continuer à faire évoluer notre plateforme vidéo IA actuelle, en enrichissant l'expérience visuelle et en lançant une nouvelle gamme de produits pour les entreprises pour aider les gens à mieux travailler.
Pourquoi ?
Parce que nous sommes convaincus que les entreprises gagnantes de demain seront celles qui sauront enseigner à leurs employés comment tirer parti de la puissance de l'IA au travail. L'automatisation est un levier de valeur majeur, mais la montée en compétences de vos effectifs pour qu’ils créent leurs propres automatisations sera plus importante encore.
Et l'humain est au cœur de notre démarche.
C’est ce qui fait notre singularité chez Synthesia : nous avons la conviction profonde que l’humain demeurera la priorité absolue des entreprises pour de très longues années encore.
Pour moi, une grande partie de notre mission consiste donc à aider les gens à mieux travailler, à former les équipes et à ajouter de l'automatisation là où elle est pertinente, afin que chacun puisse consacrer son temps à ce qui compte le plus.
Et avec ce nouveau tour de financement, c'est précisément sur cela que nous mettons les bouchées doubles.
À nos investisseurs, nouveaux et actuels, merci de soutenir non seulement un produit, mais aussi la conviction qu'il existe une meilleure façon pour les entreprises de s'adapter à l'IA et de se développer.
Les prochaines années redéfiniront la manière dont le savoir est partagé au sein des meilleures entreprises mondiales. Avec ce nouveau financement, nous avons la ferme intention d'améliorer considérablement cette expérience pour nos clients.
À nos clients, merci de nous avoir accordé votre confiance et de nous avoir incités à l'excellence en nous confiant vos projets de formation et de communication les plus ambitieux. C'est vous qui nous montrez ce qu'il est possible de réaliser avec la vidéo IA et les agents.
PDG et cofondateur

FAQ
Foire aux questions sur la vidéo IA.
Comment puis-je tester Synthesia ?
Vidéo IA gratuite :
vous pouvez générer
une vidéo gratuitement ici
.
‍
Présentation du produit gratuite :
vous pouvez regarder une
présentation gratuite de 5 minutes ici
.
‍
Démo commerciale gratuite :
si vous souhaitez tester Synthesia au sein d'une grande entreprise, vous pouvez
programmer une démo avec notre équipe commerciale ici
.
Que se passe-t-il si je dépasse la limite mensuelle de mon plan ?
Si vous dépassez votre limite, votre utilisation sera plafonnée jusqu'au renouvellement. Si vous ne souhaitez pas attendre le renouvellement, vous pouvez mettre à niveau votre plan.
Est-ce possible de voir plus d'avis clients sur Synthesia ?
Oui, bien sûr. Nous avons été reconnus « High Performer » par G2 ; vous pouvez
consulter les avis ici
.
Nous travaillons dur chaque jour pour améliorer Synthesia et rendre l'outil encore plus génial. Vous pouvez également voir nos
mises à jour de produit fréquentes ici
.
Les minutes de vidéo non utilisées sont-elles reportées au mois suivant ?
Non.
Les minutes de vidéos non utilisées de votre crédit ne sont pas reportées d'une période de facturation à l'autre.
Est-ce que je peux résilier mon plan Synthesia à tout moment ?
Yes. Vous pouvez résilier votre plan depuis les paramètres de votre compte Synthesia.
Est-ce que je peux mettre à niveau mon compte à tout moment ?
Yes. Contactez le support client pour passer de votre plan Starter ou Creator à un plan annuel et notre équipe commerciale pour passer à un plan Enterprise.
Quel est le coût de Synthesia ?
Pour les utilisateurs du plan Starter, le coût est de 29 $ par mois ou de 264 $, si vous optez pour un abonnement annuel.
Le plan Creator est à 89 $/mois ou 804 $/an si vous payez annuellement.
Est-ce que je peux utiliser Synthesia gratuitement ?
Vous pouvez tester Synthesia gratuitement en accédant à notre
page du générateur de vidéo IA gratuit
. Vous pourrez ensuite choisir un modèle de vidéo, saisir votre script vidéo et générer une vidéo gratuitement.
Le règlement du logiciel Synthesia se fait-il par le biais d'un paiement unique ?
Non, nous proposons un paiement récurrent pour l'utilisation de Synthesia. La facturation est mensuelle ou annuelle pour les utilisateurs des plans Starter et Creator et annuelle pour les clients du plan Enterprise.
Combien coûte un avatar personnalisé ?
Un avatar personnalisé est inclus dans les plans annuels Starter et Creator. Les plans Enterprise offrent un nombre illimité d'avatars personnels (sous réserve d'une utilisation raisonnable).
Combien de vidéos est-il possible de créer avec un plan Starter ?
Le plan Starter propose 10 minutes de vidéo par mois. Le nombre de vidéos que vous générez dépend de la durée de chaque vidéo.
À titre d'exemples :
Si vous générez une vidéo de 59 s, il vous restera 9 min et 01 s de vidéo à générer dans le mois.
Vous pouvez générer 10 vidéos d'1 min chacune, ou 1 vidéo de 10 min.
Comment et quand les minutes de vidéo sont-elles consommées ?
Les minutes de vidéo ne sont consommées que lorsqu'une vidéo est générée. Tant que votre vidéo est en mode brouillon, ou que vous utilisez la fonctionnalité de lecture, les crédits ne sont pas consommés.
Si vous avez généré votre vidéo et que vous souhaitez mettre à jour le contenu, vous pouvez le faire en modifiant et en générant à nouveau votre vidéo.
‍
Veuillez noter
que nous ne comptons que les nouvelles secondes de vidéo. Par exemple, si vous modifiez une vidéo existante d'une minute et que vous en modifiez 3 secondes, nous ne vous facturerons que 3 secondes.
Est-il possible de payer à la vidéo ?
Non. Synthesia propose uniquement des abonnements mensuels et annuels.

Bonjour ! Permettez-moi de vous présenter la nouvelle fonctionnalité phare de Connectly : le suivi automatique.
‍
Grâce à elle, rester en contact avec vos clients devient simple et fluide. Laissez-moi vous expliquer. Nous programmons et personnalisons automatiquement les messages dès que vous enregistrez une interaction.
Appels, réunions... chaque point de contact compte ! Désormais, plus aucun prospect ne vous échappe !
Rejoignez Connectly dès aujourd'hui et transformez vos conversations quotidiennes en relations durables.
Bonjour, je m'appelle Zhi et je vous souhaite la bienvenue dans notre équipe.
‍
Pour commencer, voici notre mission : nous transformons les grandes idées en produits simples et utiles, en pensant toujours au client.
‍
Le premier jour, concentrez-vous sur trois choses : rencontrez votre équipe (écrivez un message sur Slack, faites un signe de la main ou échangez directement avec quelqu'un). Configurez vos outils : e-mail, tchat et espace de travail.
Prenez une petite tâche et terminez-la. Rien de tel qu'une petite victoire pour prendre confiance.
Nous sommes ravis de vous accueillir dans notre équipe. Si vous avez la moindre question, contactez votre parrain/marraine, ou moi-même. C'est tout ! Nous allons faire des choses géniales ensemble !
Bonjour à tous ! Laissez-moi vous présenter Synergy Flow : l'outil de productivité le plus simple d'utilisation pour les équipes.
Avec Synergy Flow, vous pouvez suivre les tâches, analyser les performances et collaborer en temps réel.
Jetons un oeil à nos plans : nous avons le plan Pro, pour les petites équipes et les startups, le plan Pro Plus, pour les entreprises en pleine croissance,
et le plan Enterprise pour les entreprises qui ont besoin d'une sécurité avancée. Si vous ne trouvez pas le plan qui vous convient, contactez-nous.
Bonjour, je m'appelle Kayla. Bienvenue dans notre guide simple pour créer des mots de passe sécurisés.
Un mot de passe fort est la clé de votre sécurité. Il doit contenir au moins 12 caractères et combiner des majuscules, des minuscules, des chiffres et des caractères spéciaux. Évitez les mots courants ou les noms propres.
Nous vous recommandons d'utiliser des mots de passe différents pour vos comptes professionnels et personnels. Utilisez aussi systématiquement l'authentification multifacteur pour éviter les risques supplémentaires.
Restez prudent, ne partagez jamais votre mot de passe et n'hésitez pas à poser des questions. C'est tout pour aujourd'hui. Merci de votre attention.

FAQ
Les réponses à toutes vos questions sur la conversion de PPTX en vidéo
Quel est le meilleur convertisseur de PowerPoint en vidéo ?
Synthesia est le meilleur outil pour convertir PowerPoint en vidéo, car il combine des avatars IA, des voix-off naturelles et une automatisation intelligente du design pour transformer des diapositives statiques en vidéos engageantes. Il ne se limite pas à une conversion basique, il transforme votre contenu PowerPoint en scènes dynamiques, animées par plus de 240 avatars IA réalistes qui peuvent présenter vos vidéos dans plus de 140 langues et accents.
Contrairement aux autres convertisseurs qui filment simplement le défilement des diapositives, Synthesia structure votre présentation en séquences parfaitement rythmées, avec des mises en page personnalisables, des éléments de votre identité visuelle et des fonctionnalités interactives. Vous pouvez tout modifier directement en ligne, ajouter des enregistrements d'écran ou des ressources IA générées par Veo 3 et Sora, et collaborer avec votre équipe en temps réel. C'est la solution la plus complète et la plus intuitive pour transformer des présentations en vidéos de qualité, animées par un présentateur.
Le convertisseur de PowerPoint en vidéo est-il gratuit ?
Oui ! Synthesia propose un
générateur de vidéo IA
gratuit qui vous permet de convertir des présentations PowerPoint en vidéos sans aucun coût. Vous pouvez importer vos diapositives, ajouter des avatars IA et des voix-off, et créer une présentation vidéo professionnelle en quelques minutes. Cette option gratuite vous donne accès aux fonctionnalités principales de conversion de PowerPoint en vidéo et vous permet de découvrir comment l'IA transforme des diapositives statiques en contenu vidéo engageant.
Pour les équipes et les entreprises qui ont besoin de fonctionnalités avancées comme des avatars personnalisés, des kits de marque, des outils de collaboration et une création vidéo illimitée, Synthesia propose des plans payants avec davantage de possibilités. Le convertisseur gratuit est parfait pour tester la plateforme et créer vos premiers projets de conversion de PowerPoint en vidéo. Les plans payants soutiennent la croissance de votre production vidéo au niveau de votre entreprise.
Comment convertir un PowerPoint en vidéo avec l'IA ?
Il existe deux manières simples de convertir une présentation PowerPoint en vidéo avec Synthesia.
1. Utilisez le convertisseur de PowerPoint en vidéo
Importez votre fichier .pptx à l'aide de l'outil de conversion situé en haut de la page. Synthesia transforme automatiquement vos diapositives en une ébauche de vidéo complète avec des séquences et un script. Vous pouvez choisir un modèle, ajouter du contexte pour définir l'objectif, le ton, la langue et le présentateur de votre vidéo, puis personnaliser entièrement chaque élément, y compris l'avatar, la voix-off, le script, les ressources média (notamment les clips générés par l'IA) et les fonctionnalités interactives.
2. Importez votre PowerPoint dans Synthesia
Vous pouvez également importer votre PowerPoint directement dans un nouveau projet vidéo. Les diapositives sont utilisées comme arrière-plan et vous pouvez modifier les éléments de texte dans Synthesia. Les notes de la présentation importées servent de script vidéo, et les polices sont détectées automatiquement. Si certaines polices ne sont pas disponibles, vous pouvez les remplacer ou importer vos fichiers pour conserver le style de votre présentation.
Ces deux méthodes permettent de transformer facilement des diapositives statiques en vidéos engageantes animées par un présentateur, sans qu'un tournage ou un montage complexe ne soit nécessaire.
Pourquoi convertir un PowerPoint en vidéo ?
Convertir un PowerPoint en vidéo rend votre contenu plus captivant, accessible et facile à partager. Le public retient 95 % du message d'une vidéo, alors qu'il ne retient que 10 % d'un texte lu, et les vidéos sont plus faciles à visionner sur tous les appareils. Avec 78 % des gens qui regardent des vidéos chaque semaine et 55 % chaque jour, transformer vos diapositives en vidéo vous aide à capter et retenir l'attention plus efficacement.
Est-ce possible de créer un fichier MP4 à partir de PowerPoint ?
Oui, PowerPoint vous permet d'exporter des diapositives au format MP4, mais le résultat est essentiellement un diaporama automatisé avec une interactivité limitée et sans présentateur. Avec Synthesia, vous pouvez importer votre PowerPoint et le transformer en une vidéo professionnelle, avec des
avatars réalistes
, des voix-off naturelles et les éléments de votre identité visuelle. Une fois votre vidéo terminée, vous pouvez facilement l'exporter en MP4 ou la partager via un lien. Votre présentation devient ainsi plus captivante et plus facile à diffuser à grande échelle qu'une simple conversion en diaporama.
Puis-je convertir un PPTX en une vidéo avec du son ?
Oui, Synthesia vous permet de convertir des fichiers PPTX en vidéo avec des voix-off générées par l'IA. Il suffit de saisir votre script de narration, et Synthesia ajoutera une voix-off réaliste dans plus de 140 langues. Vous n'avez pas besoin d'enregistrer votre propre voix.
Puis-je transformer automatiquement les notes PowerPoint en voix-off ?
Oui, lorsque vous importez un fichier PowerPoint dans l'application Synthesia, les notes de la présentation sont automatiquement converties en voix-off naturelles parfaitement synchronisées avec vos diapositives. La plateforme extrait vos notes et les transforme en un script que les avatars IA présentent en utilisant des gestes et des intonations réalistes.
La synchronisation se fait automatiquement, mais vous gardez un contrôle total pour modifier le script, le rythme des séquences ou choisir parmi plus de 1000 voix dans plus de 140 langues et accents. Cela supprime les étapes du tournage et du montage audio complexe, et permet de remplacer des heures de production par un simple processus d'importation et quelques ajustements.
Puis-je modifier la vidéo après avoir importé mon PowerPoint ?
Oui, vous avez un contrôle total pour modifier et personnaliser votre vidéo après avoir importé des diapositives PowerPoint dans Synthesia. La plateforme propose un éditeur intuitif où vous pouvez modifier le texte, changer les avatars IA, modifier le design et ajouter de nouveaux éléments comme des images, des
enregistrements d'écran
ou des séquences générées par l'IA. Vous pouvez également changer les voix-off, sélectionner différentes langues, ajouter de la musique de fond et appliquer les couleurs et les polices de votre charte graphique pour que la vidéo soit à l'image de votre marque.
Le processus d'édition est simple et intuitif, comme sur PowerPoint, mais avec de puissantes fonctionnalités vidéo. Vous pouvez réorganiser les scènes, ajouter des animations et des transitions, insérer des éléments interactifs comme des boutons cliquables, et même générer de nouveaux visuels à l'aide de l'IA. Grâce à cette flexibilité, la conversion de votre PowerPoint en vidéo n'est que le point de départ pour créer des présentations vidéo vraiment engageantes et professionnelles.
Quels types de fichiers et quelles limites de taille sont pris en charge ?
Synthesia prend en charge les formats de fichiers PowerPoint .pptx ne dépassant pas 50 Mo. La plateforme accepte également d'autres formats, notamment les fichiers PDF, DOC, DOCX et TXT, vous offrant ainsi une flexibilité dans la manière dont vous intégrez votre contenu au processus de création vidéo.

Synthesia è un generatore di video IA gratuito?
Abbiamo lanciato un piano gratuito che ti permette di creare gratis video IA! Include 3 minuti di video al mese, 6 avatar e una gamma completa di voci generate dalla IA in oltre 140 lingue. Scopri ulteriori informazioni su tutti i

Posso personalizzare i video generati con la IA per aggiungere l'identità del marchio?
Sì, con la IA puoi creare facilmente video con sfondi, colori e logo personalizzati per il tuo marchio. Inoltre, con la nuova funzionalità esclusiva dei nostri piani aziendali Avatar Builder, puoi personalizzare gli avatar IA modificandone l'abbigliamento e aggiungendo logo e colori del marchio per rendere il tuo brand aziendale coerente e coinvolgente in ogni video.
La creazione di video IA si integra con gli LMS esistenti?
Il generatore di video IA di Synthesia si integra perfettamente con il tuo sistema di gestione dell'apprendimento (LMS), assicurando un flusso di lavoro rapido e senza intoppi. Potrai creare video IA e inserirli direttamente nei corsi e nei moduli di formazione, semplificando l'aggiornamento e la distribuzione dei materiali didattici in modo efficace.
In che modo la creazione di video IA migliora la produttività dei dipendenti?
I video IA di Synthesia permettono alle aziende di essere agili e coerenti in tutti i tipi di comunicazione e formazione interna. È un formato coinvolgente, facilmente aggiornabile, traducibile e personalizzabile, che consente alla forza lavoro di essere più informata, competente e motivata, contribuendo al successo delle iniziative di apprendimento dell'azienda e migliorando la produttività.
Per le aziende è sicuro creare video IA con Synthesia?
Synthesia fornisce alle aziende un ambiente sicuro, garantendo la protezione e il controllo completo dei dati aziendali. È conforme agli standard SOC 2 Tipo II e RGDP e dispone di un team dedicato alla sicurezza dei dati. Grazie all'integrazione di processi di moderazione umana e tramite IA e a un impegno attivo nelle politiche sull'uso della IA, Synthesia assicura un utilizzo etico e responsabile nella creazione dei video.
Cosa si può fare con il generatore di video IA di Synthesia?
Con il generatore di video IA di Synthesia è possibile creare facilmente video di qualità professionale senza le difficoltà inerenti alla ripresa e alla produzione. Riportiamo di seguito alcuni esempi che mostrano cosa si può fare:
Aggiungere avatar IA
: scegli il tuo avatar tra una vasta selezione per rendere i tuoi video più coinvolgenti e inclusivi.
Creare doppiaggi all'istante
: trasforma le tue sceneggiature in doppiaggi di alta qualità scegliendo tra le centinaia di voci dal suono naturale generate dalla IA.
Modificare video
: utilizza i modelli predefiniti e l'assistenza della IA per trasformare documenti, PDF, link a siti web o idee in video di qualità.
Collaborazione del team
: lavora con il tuo team in tempo reale e gestisci i progetti in spazi di lavoro condivisi.
Tradurre e localizzare con un solo clic
: traduci automaticamente i video in oltre 140 lingue per rendere i tuoi contenuti accessibili a livello globale.
Questo strumento è ideale per la creazione di video formativi, contenuti di marketing e video per il servizio clienti, rendendo più semplice ed efficiente il processo di produzione dei video.

Synthesiaは無料のAI動画生成ツールですか？
無料のAI動画を作成できる無料プランの提供を開始しました！3分/月の動画を作成でき、6種類のストックアバター、140を超える言語に対応したAI音声を利用できます。

AIが生成した動画をカスタマイズして、ブランドの特徴を追加することはできますか？
はい、ブランドに合った背景、色、ロゴを使用したAI動画を簡単に作成できます。さらに、コーポレートプランをご利用のお客様は専用の新機能であるアバタービルダーを使用して、服を変えたり、ロゴやブランドカラーを追加したりして、AIアバターをカスタマイズ・パーソナライズし、すべての動画でブランドの特徴を加えた一貫性のある魅力的なものにすることが可能です。
AI動画作成は既存のLMSと統合されていますか？
SynthesiaのAI動画生成ツールは、既存の学習管理システム（LMS）と簡単に連携できるように設計されており、スムーズで効率的なワークフローが実現します。AI動画を作成し、コースやトレーニングモジュールに直接埋め込むことが可能です。このシームレスな統合により、トレーニング教材の更新・配布プロセスが効率化されます。
AI動画の作成は従業員の生産性をどのように向上させますか？
Synthesiaで作成されたAI動画により、企業はあらゆる種類の社内コミュニケーションやトレーニングにおいて、アジャイルで一貫性のある対応が可能になります。更新、翻訳、カスタマイズが簡単にできる魅力的なフォーマットで、知識、スキル、モチベーションの高い人材を育成し、組織の学習イニシアチブを成功に導き、生産性を向上させます。
企業がSynthesiaでAI動画を作成するのは安全ですか？
Synthesiaは企業向けにセキュリティで保護された環境を提供し、企業のデータを安全に管理します。SynthesiaはSOC 2 Type IIおよびGDPRに準拠しており、お客様のデータの安全を守るためのチームを擁しています。人間とAIの両方のモデレーションプロセスを統合し、AIポリシーに積極的に関与することで、動画生成におけるAIの倫理的かつ責任ある使用を保証します。当社の
倫理に関するポリシー
（英語）に関する詳細をご覧ください。
SynthesiaのAI動画生成ツールでどんなことができるのですか？
SynthesiaのAI動画生成ツールなら、撮影や制作に労力をかけずに、プロ品質の動画を簡単に作成できます。以下に例を挙げます。
AIアバターの追加：より魅力的で包括的な動画にするため、多様なアバターから選択可能。
インスタントナレーションの作成：スクリプトを何百種類もの自然なAI音声の高品質なナレーションに変換。
動画の編集：あらかじめデザインされたテンプレートとAIアシスタントを使用して、ドキュメント、PDF、ウェブサイトのリンク、アイデアを洗練された動画に変換できます。
チームコラボレーション：共有ワークスペースでリアルタイムで連携しながらプロジェクトを管理できます。
ワンクリックの翻訳・ローカライズ：動画を自動的に140を超える言語に翻訳し、世界中の視聴者に届けられます。
動画制作プロセス、特にトレーニング動画、マーケティングコンテンツ、カスタマーサービス動画の作成を効率化・強化できます。

FAQs
AI training video FAQs
Can AI make training videos?
Yes, AI can
create professional training videos
by converting text into engaging video content with AI avatars, voiceovers, and visual elements. Synthesia eliminates the need for traditional
training video production
resources like cameras, studios, or actors, making it possible to produce high-quality training materials in minutes. This is one of the most practical applications of
AI in instructional design
.
AI-powered video creation is particularly valuable for L&D teams who need to scale their
employee training videos
globally. You can create consistent training content in over 140 languages, update videos instantly when information changes, and maintain brand standards across all materials. This approach helps organizations
reduce training costs
while improving engagement and retention.
Whether you're producing
compliance training videos
,
cyber security training videos
,
leadership training videos
, or
software training videos
, AI makes it faster and more scalable than ever before.
Do I need cameras, actors, or voiceover talent to create training videos with Synthesia?
No, you don't need any traditional video production equipment or talent to create
video-based training
with Synthesia. The platform uses AI avatars as presenters and generates natural-sounding voiceovers from your text, handling all the visual and audio elements automatically.
Instead of coordinating schedules with actors or booking studios, you simply type or paste your content into the platform. If you’re unsure where to start, you can use these
free training video templates
,
free training video script templates,
or learn
how to write a training video script
that keeps learners engaged.
This streamlined workflow dramatically lowers the
cost of training employees
while allowing teams to focus on strategy and instructional design rather than production logistics.
Can I translate and localize training videos into multiple languages with Synthesia?
Yes, Synthesia enables instant translation and localization of training videos into over 140 languages with just one click.
This capability is transformative for global organizations delivering
interactive training videos
or
scenario-based training
across multiple regions. The multilingual video player automatically detects viewers' language preferences, ensuring each employee receives training in their preferred language without manual intervention.
By combining localization with AI production, organizations can scale training globally while maintaining consistency, accuracy, and cultural relevance.
Can I turn existing PDFs, slides, or web pages into training videos?
Yes, Synthesia's AI Video Assistant can automatically
convert training materials into engaging videos
, including PDFs, PowerPoint presentations, and web pages. This is another great application of
AI in training and employee development.
Simply upload your document or paste a URL, and the AI analyzes the content to create a structured video script complete with visuals and narration. This feature is especially useful for teams looking to
make training more engaging
without starting from scratch.
Instead of rebuilding content manually, you can transform static documents into dynamic training experiences that improve comprehension, retention, and completion rates.
Is Synthesia secure and compliant for enterprise training content (SOC 2, GDPR)?
Yes, Synthesia is SOC 2 Type II certified and fully GDPR compliant, meeting the strict security requirements needed for enterprise training content. The platform implements comprehensive security measures to protect sensitive training materials and employee data throughout the video creation and distribution process.
Security is built into every aspect of the platform, from encrypted data storage to controlled access permissions for team collaboration. This commitment to data protection means L&D teams can confidently create training videos containing proprietary information, compliance materials, or sensitive company procedures. The platform's enterprise-grade security infrastructure ensures your training content remains protected while still being easily accessible to authorized learners across your organization.

Acceptable Use Policy
Last Updated: February 23, 2024
This Acceptable Use Policy sets out a list of acceptable and unacceptable conduct for your use of the Services and Avatars. You agree to do what is listed under the ‘General Requirements’ and to abstain from those activities listed under the ‘Categories of Prohibitions.’ You also will not authorize, enable, induce or encourage any third party to carry out those prohibited activities. If we believe a violation of the policy is deliberate, repeated or presents an undue burden or credible risk of harm to other users, customers, Synthesia, the Services or any third parties, we may suspend or terminate your access.
This policy may change as the Services and industry evolve, so please check back regularly for updates and changes. Context matters, and this Policy is not intended to restrict clearly labeled internal training, testing, educational or role-play uses of the Services (including simulations with Avatars or virtual agents) where a reasonable viewer would understand that the scenario does not describe any real person’s actual identity, role, endorsement or personal medical or other sensitive characteristics. Capitalized terms used below but not defined in this policy have the meaning set forth in the governing agreement.
GENERAL REQUIREMENTS
Comply with applicable laws and governmental regulations, including all intellectual property, data protection, privacy, artificial intelligence and export control laws.
Use the Services for your organization’s or company’s business needs, rather than for consumer, personal or household purposes.
Use commercially reasonable efforts to prevent unauthorized access and use of the Services.
Monitor and control all activity conducted through your account in connection with the Services.
Moderate the use of Avatars, including the use of voices and likenesses, to ensure that the rights and interests of individuals are being respected and the public is being protected from harm.
CATEGORIES OF PROHIBITIONS
Impersonation, Deception & Abuse of Individual Rights
Impersonating any person or entity, including any employee of ours, or falsely state or otherwise misrepresent your affiliation with a person, organization or entity, where such conduct is intended to deceive or is reasonably likely to mislead the relevant audience and where such content is produced by non-enterprise Service plans.
Violating, misappropriating or infringing a person’s right to privacy or publicity, including any of their moral or intellectual property rights.
Using the Services, or transmitting through the Services, any data or information for the purposes of committing fraud, elder-abuse or identity theft, or for the purposes of furthering any of the foregoing.
Using the Services to send altered, deceptive or false source-identifying information, including "spoofing" or "phishing".
Using the Services in a way that is obscene, defamatory, insulting, hostile, inciting, threatening, or discriminatory towards an individual or a group of individuals.
Adult Content & Abuse of Minors
Using the Services in a manner that exploits, harms, or attempts to exploit or harm minors in any way, for example by representing or portraying them with Avatars, or exposing them to inappropriate content.
Using the Services for the purpose of promoting or providing adult entertainment.
Using the Services to promote or advertise age restricted goods, services or venues, including alcohol, tobacco, vaping products, psychoactive substances, firearms, gambling, sex toys, escort services and dating services
.
Campaigns, Communications & Abuse of the Public Interest
Using the Services, or transmitting through the Services, any conspiracy theories, propaganda or data or information that is in furtherance of any ‘misinformation’ or ‘disinformation’ campaigns or activities.
Removing, deactivating or disabling any ‘watermarks’ or other mechanisms of the Services that are designed to help validate provenance or differentiate between human-generated and AI-generated content.
Using the Services to send unsolicited communications, promotions, or advertisements, including spam and robocalls.
Incorporating a Stock Avatar in content for "promoted", "boosted", or "paid" advertising on any social media platform or similar media, absent written express consent from Synthesia -
in the case of a Custom Avatar, you may do so only with appropriate consent from the individual.
Using the Services to provide material support or resources (or to conceal or disguise the nature, location, source, or ownership of material support or resources) to any organization(s) designated by either the United States as a foreign terrorist organization pursuant to section 219 of the Immigration and Nationality Act, or by the United Kingdom or European Union pursuant to similar laws and regulations concerning national security, defense or terrorism.
Using the Services in a manner that could result in the death or serious bodily injury of any person or in other catastrophic damage, including through warfare or the operation of critical infrastructure.
Synthesia Technology & Abuse of Access
Scraping any content or data from Synthesia or the Services for the creation or training of AI models or tools, including machine learning models, generative models, deep learning models, and artificial neural networks.
Uploading to, or transmitting from, the Services any data, file, software, or link that contains or redirects to a virus, Trojan horse, worm, or other harmful component or a technology that unlawfully accesses or downloads content or information stored within the Services or on the hardware of Synthesia or any third party.
Attempting to reverse engineer, decompile, hack, disable, interfere with, disassemble, modify, copy, translate, or disrupt the features, functionality, integrity, or performance of the Services (including any mechanism used to restrict or control the functionality of the Services), any third party use of the Services, or any third party data contained therein (except to the extent such restrictions are prohibited by applicable law).
Attempting to gain unauthorized access to the Services or related systems or networks or to defeat, avoid, bypass, remove, deactivate, or otherwise circumvent any software protection or monitoring mechanisms of the Services.
‍
Making the Services available to anyone other than Authorized Users.
Sublicensing, reselling, time sharing or similarly exploiting the Services.
Accessing the Services to build a competitive product or service.
Excessively, disproportionately or unreasonably consuming compute or AI-generation resources.
Abusing referrals or promotions for the Services, for example to get more credits than deserved.
Synthesia Content & Abuse of Third Party Rights
Using a Stock Avatar in a manner that is meant to, or is reasonably likely to, make viewers think the real-life actor personally holds, endorses, or actually has your stated opinions, characteristics or conditions (for example, publicly saying or strongly implying that the actor has a specific medical condition, disability or political view
)
-
in the case of Stock Avatars, you may do so only on enterprise Service plans and in the case of a Custom Avatar, you may do so only with appropriate consent from the individual.
Using a Stock Avatar in a TV program, news broadcast, fundraise or political campaign, or in the dissemination of any commentary around current events, politics or topics that may be polarizing or sensitive to certain demographics, absent written consent from Synthesia -
in the case of a Custom Avatar, you may do so only on certain Services plans and with appropriate consent from the individual.
Using a Stock Avatar to create, offer or sell any non-fungible tokens (NFTs), or incorporating any Stock Avatars therein.
Incorporating any Stock Avatars in any patents, trademarks, design-marks, or service-marks, or any registrations or filings thereof.
Using stock audio clips as musical themes or jingles in connection with any products or services.
Using stock audio clips in international television advertising campaigns if by or on behalf of an entity with annual revenues of more than one billion dollars (US$1,000,000,000).
Remixing or altering sock audio clips, except that for basic editing (e.g., setting start/stop points, and determining fade-in/fade-out points).

AI Governance Practices
Published: September, 2024
Overview
Synthesia is committed to the responsible, transparent, and secure development of artificial intelligence technologies as part of its Services (herein referred to as “
AI Components
”). This page outlines Synthesia’s approach to AI governance and compliance, structured around its guiding principles and key areas of impact. Synthesia aligns its practices with international standards, such as ISO/IEC 42001:2023, to help ensure that its AI Components are trustworthy, compliant, and suitable for the needs of its customers and society at large.
These policies and practices may change as the Services and industry evolve, so please check back regularly for updates. Capitalized terms used below but not defined in this policy have the meaning set forth in the governing agreement.
Guiding Principles
Responsible Innovation
Synthesia is guided by a framework of responsible artificial intelligence innovation whereby it adheres to its founding principles of
Consent, Control and Collaboration
throughout its AI supply chain. This means Synthesia requires that each person consent before their voice or likeness is cloned for an avatar, whether it’s for a Stock Avatar available to all customers, or a Custom Avatar (e.g., Personal Avatar) that is created by and on behalf of a specific customer. Synthesia’s platform and policies are also integrated with a trust and safety layer that is designed to help prevent the generation and distribution of harmful content. This includes a prescriptive
Acceptable Use Policy
that is supported by a dedicated Trust and Safety Team and further operationalized by automated and manual verification and content moderation tools and filters. And lastly, Synthesia partners with regulatory bodies, media organizations, and research institutions to develop best practices and educate its customers and the industry on the responsible use of AI. For example, Synthesia is a launch partner in the Partnership on AI (PAI) on Responsible Practices for Synthetic Media and a founding member of the Content Authenticity Initiative.
Rights of Customers
Synthesia is committed to respecting the rights of organizations and businesses that use its Services, by communicating transparently and empowering them with choice. The Services, and Synthesia’s related practices, incorporate measures designed to respect their intellectual property rights, protect their data, and maintain confidentiality. As further described below in the section titled ‘Governing Agreements,’ Customers own the content they generate using the Services, and are not responsible for Synthesia’s separate R&D and development decisions. Synthesia handles customer data in accordance with its customers’ written instructions while adhering to rigorous security and confidentiality safeguards and standards.
Rights of Individuals
Synthesia is deeply committed to upholding the rights of individuals and to protect the public from harmful content and misuse of AI technologies. Synthesia’s
Acceptable Use Policy
prohibits the use of Services for activities that infringe on individual rights, such as creating defamatory, inciteful, abusive, or discriminatory content. Synthesia enforces these restrictions to help ensure that the AI Components are used responsibly, aligning with the broader goal of safeguarding privacy, promoting freedom of expression within ethical bounds, and preventing discrimination. Furthermore, Synthesia’s
Content Integrity Policy
offers individuals a streamlined process to report copyright and privacy concerns regarding content generated by users.
Key Areas of Impact
Accountability & Explainability
Synthesia and its customers have a shared responsibility to prevent abuse and mitigate harm. To foster clarity and initiative between the parties in this regard, Synthesia integrates a structured approach to defining roles and reinforcing responsibilities along the entire AI supply chain, beginning with R&D and model creation and extending through to customer deployment.
Roles under Regulations
Synthesia’s role and responsibilities, as well as those of its customers, shift based on the stage of the AI supply chain and the applicable legal framework. When creating and pre-training AI Components, Synthesia serves as the “controller” under privacy frameworks like GDPR and the UK GDPR, and when making these components available to customers as part of the Services, it serves as a “provider” under AI frameworks like the EU AI Act. However, once customers choose to use the Services, they take on the role of “deployer” under the EU AI Act, and under privacy law, they assume the responsibilities of the controller (as they determine the purposes and means of processing), while Synthesia transitions to the role of “processor” (as it processes the data on behalf of the customer). To the best of Synthesia’s knowledge, its AI Components, when used as intended and in accordance with the
Acceptable Use Policy
, are not classified as High-Risk AI Systems under the EU AI Act.
Customer Choice
The Services are intended for use by businesses of all sizes, across diverse industries and geographies. As a processor and provider of the Services, Synthesia offers features and controls to help customers meet their unique compliance obligations, however, it is ultimately the customers' responsibility to deploy and use the Services in accordance with the laws that apply to them. For instance, paying customers can elect to use Synthesia’s script or editor features to embed audio or visual markers in their videos for transparency purposes under the EU AI Act, though all freemium videos already include watermarks by default. Please review the
Help Center
for more information about other features and controls available to customers, for example, how to provision or deprovision access to videos, enable or disable third party integrations, and manage permissions, retention and export settings.
Internal Governance & Policies
Synthesia’s internal governance and policies are designed to ensure that roles and responsibilities are defined and enforced for AI Component development and monitoring. The following are examples of roles designed to oversee AI-related decisions and their impacts:
AI Governance Council
: This committee is responsible for reviewing AI-related decisions, particularly those that may have ethical implications, such as the development of new AI features, to ensure they align with Synthesia’s responsible AI standards, further described in the section below titled ‘Responsible AI Development.’
Data Protection Officer
: This role involves overseeing data management practices, including ensuring data quality, provenance, and compliance with data protection regulations.
Security & Compliance Teams:
Synthesia’s formal information security program, as detailed in Synthesia’s SOC-2 Type II audit report (available in the
Synthesia Trust Portal
), includes clearly defined information security roles, responsibilities, and accountability. These individuals help ensure that the AI Components are secure and comply with relevant regulations.
Engineering and Research Leads
: These individuals are responsible for the design and development of AI Components and follow “Secure Development Lifecycle” processes to ensure they meet technical, ethical, and legal requirements.
Customer Support Liaison
: This role is dedicated to managing customer interactions related to AI Components, ensuring transparency and providing clear explanations.
Governing Agreements
Synthesia’s governing agreements with its customers are designed to promote accountability by allocating the rights, responsibilities and remedies of a party based upon their relative ability to exercise control and influence over the means and purposes of processing. For example, Synthesia offers an IP indemnification to its customers for the content and technology Synthesia provides, because as between the parties, Synthesia unilaterally makes its own R&D decisions, it is more incentivized to protect it, and it is in a better position to avoid infringement claims and navigate defenses. Similarly, Synthesia believes it’s appropriate for a customer to indemnify it for the content that they generate because Synthesia is a passive service provider – the customer has agency to write its own scripts, to direct avatars to speak and perform, to generate final videos and to distribute and post them.
Explainability
Synthesia is committed to making its AI Components understandable and explainable to customers and their users. The inherent transparency of the Services, where AI outputs are directly tied to customer-provided inputs, ensures that discrepancies between expected and actual outputs are immediately apparent. This clear linkage between input (scripts, voice, likeness) and output (avatar performance) provides a straightforward explanation, allowing customers to both trust and effectively interact with its systems, but also to anticipate harmful scenarios and mitigate abuse.
Fairness & Transparency
Synthesia’s AI Components are designed and operated to help ensure equitable outcomes for its customers and their users. Synthesia implements bias mitigation strategies at multiple stages of the AI lifecycle, from performance data collection to model development that are designed to avoid discrimination based on race, gender, age, and other protected characteristics. Regular audits and bias assessments are conducted to monitor and correct emerging biases.
Inclusive Sourcing
Synthesia prioritizes inclusive sourcing, production and design principles to ensure that its AI Components are clear, accessible, customizable and beneficial to a diverse range of customers, across a variety of industries and geographies. This includes the careful selection of actors, models and performances for the creation of stock avatars, the implementation of fairness constraints during model training, and the ongoing evaluation of AI Component outputs to ensure they do not stereotype or disadvantage any group.
Transparency-by-Design
Transparency is inherent to the Services given their nature. Once customers script and prompt a performance, they can generate a video and assess the outputs (e.g., the avatars performed the scenes and delivered the content in a photorealistic and engaging manner, as intended). Transparency is also fundamental to Synthesia’s AI practices. In its governing agreements, as supplemented by this page, Synthesia provides its customers with information about its data processing practices, the measures it takes to help ensure fairness and accountability (e.g., enforcement of the
Acceptable Use Policy
via its
Content Moderation Guidelines
), the responsible AI considerations integrated into AI development life-cycle, and its commitment to explainable AI. Further, Synthesia operates
Research & Development
initiatives whereby it collaborates with academic institutions and consortiums to publish research and white papers and to open source certain information.
Training, Data and Provenance
Synthesia specializes in developing AI Components that generate photorealistic performances of avatars, tailored for use within its enterprise video creation tools. Synthesia does not develop or offer standalone or general-purpose AI models. Accordingly, Synthesia’s approach to AI development is focused on identifying and understanding the physical and human elements of a performance, so that it can learn how their sequences, correlations and interactions come together to make movement, expression and emotion seem natural and engaging. In order to infer those subtleties that will make avatar performances also appear realistic and compelling, Synthesia pre-trains its AI Components using performances by paid actors and models that Synthesia commissions, performances made public, and performances that Synthesia licenses.
No Customer Data
Synthesia does not use Customer Data, including inputs or outputs, to pre-train its AI Components. Any processing of Customer Data that requires, or results in, the fine-tuning of AI Components is subject to the written instruction of the customer, in accordance with their governing agreement.
Documented Practices
Synthesia establishes and maintains a documented process for tracking the origin and history of performance data used to develop its AI Components, however, the specifics of the data sets and their preparation processes are proprietary and confidential, and only disclosed in certain cases, such as where Synthesia is required by law to do so. Synthesia does disclose and publish certain datasets it develops through academic partnerships or open source initiatives, such as the
Actors HQ
dataset.
Security and Privacy
Synthesia employs appropriate data protection and privacy measures designed to ensure that its AI Components are developed in a privacy-centric and compliant manner, and that their use by customers, including any processing of Customer Data, is safeguarded and secure.
Synthesia adheres to the principles of data minimization, encryption, and secure storage.

Security by design and by default is integral to Synthesia’s AI development process. Synthesia implements industry-leading security practices, including secure coding, regular penetration testing, and continuous vulnerability assessments. Synthesia’s AI Components are designed to be resilient to both accidental failures and malicious attacks, in order to help protect the integrity and confidentiality of AI-generated outputs.
Synthesia is SOC2 Type II compliant; more information about Synthesia’s security practices can be found in its
Security Practices Page
.
Safety and Health
Synthesia recognizes the potential impact of AI Components on the physical and mental well-being of individuals. Accordingly, Synthesia designs its AI Components with safety as a primary concern, implementing safeguards to prevent harm, for example, by requiring that all customers and users abide by the
Acceptable Use Policy
, and moderating content at the point of generation, using algorithmic and manual means.
Red Teaming
Synthesia regularly tests its trust and safety measures, using independent experts, to test the robustness of safety systems. Practices, such as red teaming content moderation, are then used to further improve our safeguards.
Ethical Impact Assessments
Synthesia’s AI development process includes comprehensive ethical impact assessments by its internal AI Governance Council that are conducted prior to launching any new AI feature or update. These assessments are designed to evaluate potential psychological and emotional impacts on users and the broader public. For example, Synthesia requires that avatars which replicate a person’s voice or likeness, are used in a manner that respects the dignity and autonomy of the individuals involved.
Financial and Economic Impact
Synthesia assesses the economic impact of its AI Components on individuals and groups, and implements moderation processes designed to prevent financial harm by way of impersonation, fraud or misinformation campaigns. Synthesia continuously evaluates potential scenarios where AI outputs could influence financial decisions and iteratively improves its moderation practices and filters to stay ahead of emerging trends, tactics and potential for abuse.
Accessibility
Synthesia is committed to making its AI Components and Services accessible, regardless of ability. This includes support for assistive technologies, adherence to accessibility standards, and continuous improvement based on customer and user feedback. To date, Synthesia incorporates a range of accessibility features into its platform. For example, Synthesia offers customizable contrast-ratios, and text-to-speech and text-to-video options to accommodate users with certain impairments. Further, auto-generated subtitles can be included in videos by default, or when downloaded by the user for distribution.
Ongoing Improvements & Audits
Synthesia is committed to the continuous monitoring and improvement of its AI Components. It regularly monitors AI performance, incorporates customer feedback, and adapts to new developments in AI technology and regulation.
Further, Synthesia has a robust audit system in place designed to continuously monitor its AI Components for compliance with the principles and tenets described in this document. Auditing is performed by internal parties as well as respected and accredited external firms. Synthesia undergoes a periodic ISO/IEC 42001:2023 audit and publishes its certificate on the
Synthesia Trust Portal
, when available. Further, Synthesia has performed an artificial intelligence impact assessment regarding its AI Components, which customers may access at
https://security.synthesia.io/documents
.

Content Integrity Policy
Synthesia Legal Hub
Policies
Content Integrity Policy
Content Integrity Policy
At Synthesia, we are committed to protecting intellectual property rights and individual rights to privacy. These commitments are reflected in our Acceptable Use Policy as well as in this policy, which explains how you can report violations of these rights, to the extent they arise from content published and publicly disseminated by Customers and their Authorized Users using Synthesia’s services. In the event of any inconsistency or overlap between the scope or provisions of this Synthesia Takedown Policy and the Data Request Policy, the provisions of the Data Request Policy will control.
Copyright Takedown Process
We take the intellectual property rights of others seriously and require that our Customers and their Authorized Users do the same.
If you own a copyright or have authority to act on behalf of a copyright owner
and want to report a claim that a third party is infringing that material from Synthesia’s service, please send a notice to our copyright agent that includes all of the items below and we will expeditiously take appropriate action:
A description of the copyrighted work that you claim is being infringed;
A description of the material you claim is infringing and that you want removed or access to which you want disabled and the URL or other location of that material;
Your address, telephone number, and email address;
The following statement: “I have a good faith belief that the use of the copyrighted material I am complaining of is not authorized by the copyright owner, its agent, or the law (e.g., as a fair use)”;
The following statement: “The information in this notice is accurate and, under penalty of perjury, I am the owner, or authorized to act on behalf of the owner, of the copyright or of an exclusive right that is allegedly infringed”; and
An electronic or physical signature of the owner of the copyright or a person authorized to act on the owner's behalf.
Our designated copyright agent to receive such claims can be reached as follows:
By mail:
Copyright Agent
c/o Synthesia Limited
20 Triton St,
London NW1 3BF, UK
By email:
legal@synthesia.io
We may, in appropriate circumstances, disable or terminate the accounts of users who may be repeat infringers.
This process does not limit our ability to pursue any other remedies we may have to address suspected infringement.
Privacy Takedown Process
If you discover published content that you believe violates your privacy rights, please contact us at
legal@synthesia.io
. The subject line of the email should read “Privacy Takedown Report” and must include:
(1) Your full name,
(2) URL of the disputed content or other information necessary to identify the disputed content,
(3) What personal information is included in the disputed content and evidence that such information relates to you,
(4) Information about how you came across the disputed content.
Please note that only individuals, and not organizations or companies, may avail themselves of this process; the following is an overview:
1. Initial Content Assessment
: Upon receiving a complaint, we will evaluate whether the content was published, and is still available from Synthesia’s services.
2. Initial Process Assessment
: Synthesia’s services are intended for businesses and as a general principle, the Customer owns and controls any content they and their Authorized Users create and publish using the services. For that reason, Synthesia will make an initial determination, in its sole and absolute discretion, whether this process may be followed, or instead the request should more suitably be made under the Data Request Policy.
3. Notification to Customer
: If the request is valid and appropriate, we will inform the applicable Customer of the complaint and request a written response.
4. Resolution
: If the Customer removes or alters the content published through Synthesia’s services to exclude your personally identifiable information, the request will be considered resolved.
5. Final Determination
: If the Customer does not act on the request or provides reasoning for continued storage or display of the content, we will assess whether the disputed content violates our Acceptable Use Policy. If found in violation, we will remove the content from our servers and notify you and the content creator of the removal.
Additional Considerations
Please note that the disputed content may be available on platforms outside our control. While we strive to address privacy concerns promptly, we cannot guarantee the removal of content from external sources.
For further information and to report a privacy violation, contact us at
legal@synthesia.io
.

Cookie Policy
Synthesia Legal Hub
Policies
Cookie Policy
Effective as of 26 June 2024
At Synthesia, we believe in being transparent about how we collect and use data. This policy provides information about how and when we use cookies for these purposes. Capitalized terms used in this policy but not defined have the meaning set forth in our
Privacy Policy
, which also includes additional details about the collection and use of information at Synthesia.
What is a cookie?
Cookies are small text files sent by us to your computer or mobile device, which enables Synthesia features and functionality. They are unique to your account or your browser. Session-based cookies last only while your browser is open and are automatically deleted when you close your browser. Persistent cookies last until you or your browser delete them or until they expire.
To find out more about cookies, visit
this site
.
Does Synthesia use cookies?
Yes. Synthesia uses cookies and similar technologies like single-pixel gifs and web beacons. We use both session-based and persistent cookies. Synthesia sets and accesses our own cookies on the domains operated by Synthesia and its corporate affiliates (collectively, the “
Sites
”). In addition, we use third party cookies, like Google Analytics.
How is Synthesia using cookies?
Some cookies are associated with your account and personal information in order to remember that you are logged in and which workspaces you are logged into. Other cookies are not tied to your account but are unique and allow us to carry out analytics and customization, among other similar things.
Cookies can be used to recognize you when you visit a Site or use our Services, remember your preferences, and give you a personalized experience that’s consistent with your settings. Cookies also make your interactions faster and more secure.
‍

Categories of Use

Description

Authentication

If you're signed in to our Services, cookies help us show you the right information and personalize your experience.

Security

We use cookies to enable and support our security features, and to help us detect malicious activity.

Preferences, features and services

Cookies can tell us which language you prefer and what your communications preferences are. They can help you fill out forms on our Sites more easily. They also provide you with features, insights, and customized content.

Marketing

We may use cookies to help us deliver marketing campaigns and track their performance (e.g., a user visited our Help Center and then made a purchase). Similarly, our partners may use cookies to provide us with information about your interactions with their services, but use of those third-party cookies would be subject to the service provider’s policies. Marketing cookies are limited to our Websites and are not used in our Services.

Performance, Analytics and Research

Cookies help us learn how well our Sites and Services perform. We also use cookies to understand, improve, and research products, features, and services, including to create logs and record when you access our Sites and Services from different devices, such as your work computer or your mobile device. These cookies are limited to our Websites and are not used in our Services.

‍
How are cookies used for advertising purposes?
Cookies and other ad technology such as beacons, pixels, and tags help us market more effectively to users that we and our partners believe may be interested in Synthesia. They also help provide us with aggregated auditing, research, and reporting, and know when content has been shown to you. These cookies are limited to our Sites and are not used in our Services.
What can you do if you don't want cookies to be set or want them to be removed, or if you want to opt out of interest-based targeting?
Some people prefer not to allow cookies, which is why most browsers give you the ability to manage cookies to suit you. In some browsers you can set up rules to manage cookies on a site-by-site basis, giving you more fine-grained control over your privacy. What this means is that you can disallow cookies from all sites except those that you trust.
Browser manufacturers provide help pages relating to cookie management in their products. Please see below for more information.
Google Chrome
Internet Explorer
Mozilla Firefox
Safari (Desktop)
Safari (Mobile)
Android Browser
Opera
Opera Mobile
For other browsers, please consult the documentation that your browser manufacturer provides.
You can opt out of interest-based targeting provided by participating ad servers through the Digital Advertising Alliance (
http://optout.aboutads.info/
). In addition, on your iPhone, iPad or Android, you can change your device settings to control whether you see online interest-based ads.
If you limit the ability of websites and applications to set cookies, you may worsen your overall user experience and/or lose the ability to access the services, since it will no longer be personalized to you. It may also stop you from saving customized settings, like login information.
‍

Customer Extension Period

that the Exportable Data has been successfully exported or (b) the expiration of the Transition Period (the “

for multi-year Order Forms, the value of any discounts Synthesia provided to Customer.

Customer Terms of Service
Effective: February 23, 2024
These Customer Terms of Service (the “
Customer Terms
”) describe your rights and responsibilities when using our video creation platform, including associated tools, functionality and artificial intelligence components, made available at
www.synthesia.io
(the “
Services
”). Please read them carefully. If you are a Customer (defined below), these Customer Terms govern your access and use of our Services. If you are an individual that a Customer is inviting to use the Services, the
User Terms of Service
(the “
User Terms
”) govern your access and use of the Services.
THE CONTRACT
These “Customer Terms” Form a Part of a Binding “Contract”
These Customer Terms (or, if applicable, your written agreement with us) and any Order Form(s) (defined below) together form a binding “
Contract
” between Customer and us. If any terms in the
Customer-Specific Supplement
apply to Customer (e.g., if Customer is a U.S. government entity), those terms are also incorporated herein by reference and form part of the Contract. “We,” “our” and “us” refers to the applicable Synthesia entity in the section titled “Which Synthesia Entity is Customer Contracting With?” below.

Customer Terms of Service
Your Agreement On Behalf of “Customer”
If you purchase subscription(s) to the Services, invite individuals to use the Services, or use or allow use of the Services after being notified of a change to these Customer Terms, you acknowledge your understanding of the then-current Contract and agree to the Contract on behalf of Customer. Please make sure you have the necessary authority to enter into the Contract on behalf of Customer before proceeding.
ABOUT CUSTOMER CHOICES, CONTENT & CONFIGURATIONS
Who is “Customer”?
“Customer
” is the organization that you represent in agreeing to the Contract. If the Services are being set up by someone who is not formally affiliated with an organization, Customer is the individual setting them up. If you signed up for a plan using your corporate email domain, your organization is Customer, and Customer can modify and re-assign roles for your Services (including your role) and otherwise exercise its rights under the Contract. If Customer elects to replace you as the representative with ultimate authority for the Services, we will provide you with notice following such election and you agree to take any actions reasonably requested by us or Customer to facilitate the transfer of authority to a new representative of Customer.
Who is an “Authorized User”?
Under the Contract, an “
Authorized User
” is an individual, such as an employee, contractor or client of Customer, who is invited by Customer to use the Services. Depending on the subscription plan in effect and how Customer elects to configure the Services, Authorized Users may have varying levels of roles, access and permission. For example, certain Authorized Users may have broad access and permission and can create and generate videos while others may only be able to comment on videos.
What are “Avatars” and “Synthesia Content”?
Authorized Users may access and use certain types of content that we make generally available through the Services, such as stock avatars, images, audio clips, and video templates (“
Synthesia Content
”) or they can create or upload their own. Note that “Synthesia Content” excludes Non-Synthesia Products (defined below). Using content together with the features and functionalities of the Services, including the artificial intelligence components, Authorized Users can build scenes and direct Avatars to read scripts and act them out in realistic manners. “
Avatars
” are digital representations of humans and include both those created for, and made generally available to customers of a particular Services plan (“
Stock Avatars
”) and those created specifically for, and at the direction of Customer (“
Custom Avatars
”). Check out our
Help Center
for more information about Avatars.
What is “Customer Data”?
“
Customer Data
” is any (a) content or information submitted by Authorized Users to the Services, such as text and scripts used to prompt Avatars to speak and perform, and image and audio files uploaded to the Services; and (b) any videos created by Authorized Users using the Services. “Customer Data” excludes the Services, Synthesia Content, Non-Synthesia Products and Usage Information (defined below). Customer may exclusively provide us with instructions on what to do with Customer Data. For example, Customer may provision or deprovision access to Customer Data, enable or disable third party integrations, manage permissions, retention and export settings and publish or distribute Customer Data to third party sites. Since these choices and instructions may result in the access, use, disclosure, modification or deletion of certain or all Customer Data, please review the
Help Center
for more information about these choices and instructions.
Customer will (a) inform Authorized Users of all Customer policies and practices that are relevant to their use of the Services, including the use of any Avatars, and of any settings that may impact the processing of Customer Data; and (b) ensure the transfer and processing of Customer Data under the Contract is lawful.
HIGHLIGHTED VIDEO

Ordering Subscriptions
Subscriptions allow Customer and its Authorized Users to access the Services and to create, edit and generate videos. A subscription is required for each individual and may be procured through the Services interface, or in some cases, via an order form entered into between Customer and us (each, an “
Order Form
”). Please see the
Help Center
for more information on how to procure subscriptions, how to invite Authorized Users and how the types of subscriptions are categorized. Subscriptions commence when we make them available to Customer and continue for the term specified in the Services “check-out” interface or in the Order Form, as applicable. We sometimes enter into other kinds of ordering arrangements, but that would need to be spelled out and agreed to in an Order Form. During an active subscription term, adding more subscriptions is fairly easy. Unless the Order Form says otherwise, Customer may invite additional Authorized Users at the price stated in the Order Form and all will terminate on the same date.
